title: Project Security Officer
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. Join us as a Project Security Officer, where you’ll be the primary security interface for the Nyx project, connecting Mission Operations with central security functions, engineering teams, suppliers, and external partners. You’ll translate requirements into practical, verifiable controls across our mission systems, working hands-on with engineers, technicians, and operators from concept through operations. Applications at all seniority levels are considered. Key Responsibilities Act as the single point of contact for security-related topics on the Nyx project. Translate company policies, customer requirements, regulations, and threat intelligence into project-specific security requirements, architectures, procedures, and verification criteria. Maintain the integrated project security risk picture across cyber, physical, personnel, supply-chain, export-control, and security-architecture domains. Flow security requirements into systems, subsystems, suppliers, and operations, and verify their implementation with objective evidence. Work hands-on with engineers and the security team to implement secure configurations, access controls, segmentation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, encryption, and other cybersecurity controls. Support threat modelling, risk assessments, security-by-design, system reviews, supplier assessments, security readiness, and assurance activities throughout the project lifecycle. What we would love to see from you: The ideal candidate will have: Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity engineering, systems security, infrastructure security, operational technology, embedded security, project security, or a related hands-on field. Experience working across multiple technical domains, such as networks, operating systems, applications, communications, embedded systems, hardware, or data centers. Experience translating security requirements, policies, regulations, or customer expectations into system designs, technical controls, configurations, tests, procedures, and objective evidence. Experience in security risk management, including risk-based vulnerability prioritization, threat and risk analysis, security testing, incident response, supplier and supply-chain security, and secure system integration. Practical experience configuring, hardening, troubleshooting, or monitoring real systems—not only reviewing designs or producing documentation. Ability to integrate cyber, physical, personnel, supply-chain, export-control, and security-architecture considerations into a coherent project-security approach. Strong communication, organization, project-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build trust across Corporate IT, engineering, suppliers, central security functions, and Mission Operations. Bonus qualifications: Experience working with operators in control rooms, mission-control environments, NOCs, SOCs, launch campaigns, test operations, or other time-critical operational settings. Experience securing spacecraft, launch systems, ground stations, mission-control centers, satellite communications, telemetry systems, or other complex control systems. Experience integrating security into system design, supplier agreements, procurement, verification, acceptance, and operational readiness. Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity, space, export-control, or customer frameworks, including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, IEC 62443, ECSS, or applicable national requirements. Relevant certifications or demonstrated experience with security tooling, automation, vulnerability assessment, monitoring, detection, or incident response. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc. title: Customer Support Team Lead
description: UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services . We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance, and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. We are a certified B Corporation , upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society. ✨ Our values Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. 🤝 The team You will join our Support team as the direct manager of a group of Support Engineers. While the function operates globally, with part of the team in Paris and the rest in New York, this specific role is based in Paris . You will report to Matthieu , Global Head of Scale CS, and your manager, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also partner closely with Support Operations, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, and IT. You will also be part of the global Go-To-Market community across our international offices. Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide: Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth Support Engineers : Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience 🖋️ Your responsibilities As Support Team Lead, you will be the direct manager of our Support Engineers and accountable for the team's day-to-day performance, development, and service delivery. You will translate our Support strategy into effective routines, consistent execution, and an excellent customer experience. This is a player-coach role . Your primary focus is managing and developing the team, but you'll stay close to operations , supporting complex investigations, reviewing ticket quality, and coordinating escalations when needed. The Head of Support defines the strategy and long-term evolution of the function. You make sure the team delivers on it every day. We're looking for someone who is a natural people developer : accountable, structured, thorough, calm under pressure, data-informed, proactive, and collaborative. We strongly believe in growing our people internally, and this role is also a strong stepping stone toward broader Support and Customer Success leadership for those who want to keep growing. People Management & Team Development Directly manage, coach, and develop the Support Engineers to help them perform at their best and grow in their careers: Hold regular one-to-ones, set clear expectations, and provide frequent, actionable feedback Monitor individual performance, address issues when needed, and lead performance reviews and development plans Identify skills gaps and organize coaching, training, and knowledge-sharing Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, and participate in hiring Foster a culture of customer empathy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement Daily Service Delivery & Escalation Management Own the daily delivery of Support and act as the first point of management escalation for complex, urgent, or sensitive cases: Monitor ticket queues, backlog, workload, and service levels, and ensure tickets are correctly prioritized and followed through Organize team coverage (absences, shifts, peak periods) and step in when service delivery is at risk Review and coordinate escalated tickets, defining next steps and involving the right internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success) Coordinate customer communication on significant cases, and escalate major risks or executive concerns to the Head of Support Quality, Process, & Performance Maintain high standards of technical quality, and bring a critical, structured eye to how Support operates today, proposing and driving changes rather than simply preserving the status quo: Identify where tickets could be resolved faster and more efficiently in writing, and reduce the number of cases that unnecessarily escalate into calls, especially multi-stakeholder ones, to protect everyone's time and improve the ROI of customer interactions Review ticket quality using QA tools and scorecards, and coach the team based on the results Ensure investigations are structured, well-documented, and clearly communicated to customers Monitor operational and quality indicators (backlog, response/resolution time, CSAT, quality scores) to identify risks and drive corrective action Document, monitor adoption of, and continuously improve Support workflows, in partnership with Support Operations Cross-functional Collaboration Make sure Support works effectively with the rest of the business. Coordinate with Product and Engineering on customer investigations and product issues Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales on customer situations requiring Support involvement, and continuously refine which team owns which type of request across the client lifecycle Clarify responsibilities and handovers between Support and other teams, and represent the team's operational needs in cross-functional discussions To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Zendesk (or an equivalent ticketing platform), our data stack tools, Microsoft Office, UpSlide, and internal knowledge-base tools (or local equivalents). ⚡Your goals You will be assessed on: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Time to Resolution (TTR) Ticket-to-active-user ratio Team engagement and development You are a great fit if you have: Proven experience managing or leading a customer-facing team, ideally in B2B SaaS, technical support, or a similar operational environment Strong coaching and people-development skills, including the ability to give clear, constructive, and sometimes difficult feedback Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities across a team Experience using service or operational metrics to identify issues and improve performance Strong customer communication and escalation-management skills Ability to understand technical issues and guide structured investigations, without needing to personally own every ticket Fluent in French & English mandatory Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and other customer-facing teams A pragmatic, accountable approach to problem-solving, with a bias for ownership over escalation We’d love it if you have: Experience directly managing a team of five or more people Experience supporting Enterprise customers Experience with Microsoft 365, Office add-ins, deployment, or IT environments Familiarity with Zendesk or a similar ticketing platform Experience with quality and knowledge management, or Support Operations Experience supporting distributed or international teams Familiarity with automation, AI-assisted Support, or self-service strategies ✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why. Recruitment process Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role. Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your management experience in Support. Case study and a team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps. 🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks. What we offer 🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries 🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH , which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management 🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year) 🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc. 💻 Hybrid work: 2-3 days in-office per week 🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget 💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities 👶 Family support: Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement Flexible return to work options An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent ✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day) ✅ General: Meal vouchers (Tickets resto): €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year) Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle): Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children Commute (Transports): Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨ Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Key Account Executive
description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. Tu parles anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés. Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires. Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client. Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence. Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers… Processus de recrutement : Entretien téléphonique RH. Entretien avec le manager. Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif. Entretien final avec la Direction. Localisation : Montagnat (01) et Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour par semaine sur chaque site et 3 jours de télétravail. Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE RÔLE Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact. VOS MISSIONS Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion. Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison. Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés. Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image. Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison. Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…). Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations. Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants. Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports. Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication. VOTRE PROFIL Excellente culture graphique et artistique. Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques. Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs. Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere. Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint. Très bonne maîtrise du motion design. Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création. Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes. title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d) | Bonn
description: Über uns Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen. Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Bei hairfree erwarten dich klare Strukturen, moderne Prozesse, ein starkes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Deine Rolle Als Beauty Sales Consultant / Kundenberater (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserer Lounge in Bonn. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Interessentinnen und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Beratung, sondern darum, Vertrauen aufzubauen, Bedürfnisse zu erkennen und unsere Kundinnen für die passende Behandlungslösung zu begeistern. Das Beste: Du arbeitest ausschließlich mit Hot-Leads. Das bedeutet, du erhältst täglich vorqualifizierte Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben. Was dich bei uns erwartet Attraktives Grundgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provisionen Flexible Arbeitszeiten Hohe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (Coaching, Academy, interne Trainings) Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Unternehmens Mitarbeiter-Events & Teamkultur Moderne Arbeitsumgebung & gute Ausstattung Mitarbeiter-Rabatte / Vergünstigungen Flache Hierarchien & offene Kommunikation Klare Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten, zum Beispiel zur Teamleitung Wertschätzung, Teamgeist und gemeinsame Erfolgserlebnisse Gute Erreichbarkeit & Parkplätze Deine Aufgaben Du berätst warme Leads, die bereits Interesse an hairfree gezeigt haben, und baust durch eine empathische und überzeugende Kommunikation Vertrauen auf. Du erkennst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Interessent*innen und führst sie professionell bis zur verbindlichen Terminbuchung. Du fasst offene Kontakte zuverlässig nach und stellst sicher, dass kein potenzieller Kunde verloren geht. Du übernimmst die vertriebliche Verantwortung für deinen Standort und entwickelst ihn gemeinsam mit deinem Team erfolgreich weiter. Du behältst Umsatzziele, Vertriebskennzahlen und die Auslastung des Standorts jederzeit im Blick und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab. Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeitenden im Vertriebsalltag, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Du sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Vertriebsstandards eingehalten und Kundenanfragen schnell sowie verbindlich bearbeitet werden. Du dokumentierst Gespräche, Termine und relevante Kundeninformationen sorgfältig in unserem digitalen System. Du arbeitest eng mit der Vertriebsleitung und den anderen Standorten zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um Prozesse, Ergebnisse und die Kundenerfahrung kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Und das Beste: Du wirst Schritt für Schritt eingearbeitet und erhältst regelmäßige Trainings, damit du sicher, professionell und erfolgreich in deine Rolle hineinwächst. Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen und kannst durch deine offene, empathische Art schnell Vertrauen aufbauen. Du bringst Interesse an Beauty, Haut, Ästhetik und dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ mit. Du arbeitest gerne vertriebsorientiert und hast Spaß daran, Kund*innen zu beraten, zu überzeugen und zum Abschluss zu begleiten. Du kommunizierst klar, professionell und wertschätzend – am Telefon, im persönlichen Gespräch und im Team. Du bist zuverlässig, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Kontakten und Terminen den Überblick. Du arbeitest zielorientiert, motiviert und hast Lust, dich fachlich sowie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, in der Kundenberatung, im Beauty-Bereich, in der Kosmetik oder im Dienstleistungsumfeld ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Auch Quereinsteiger (m/w/d) mit Verkaufstalent und Begeisterung für Beauty sind herzlich willkommen. Warum hairfree? Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Der Bewerbungsprozess ist bei uns unkompliziert und schnell, du musst kein langes Anschreiben vorbereiten, ein kurzer Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Start völlig aus. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? </p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic. </li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong>: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar</li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages </li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong> </strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours</li> <li><strong>Work with other innovators. </strong>Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)</li> <li><strong>Kickstart your career. </strong>Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks </strong></h2> <p>🏆 <strong>Rewarding Impact from Day One</strong></p> <p>You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.</p> <p><strong>🍎Learning & development </strong></p> <p>Our <strong>Future Leaders Graduate Program - Business Analytics</strong> is designed to offer you a steep learning curve by taking business ownership and end-to-end responsibility early on. You’ll get to learn by doing, while mentored by our Picnic leaders that had a similar journey like you. Next to that, you’ll benefit from other opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already do in this program. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. </p> <p><strong>🗺️Relocation</strong></p> <p>If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. </p> <p> <strong>🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks </strong></p> <p>Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.</p> <p><strong>⛳All the rest </strong></p> <p>At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. We subsidise your Deutschlandticket and with the Lease-a-Bike you can get to work sustainably and healthily. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.</p> <h3><strong>FAQ</strong></h3> <p><strong>Do I need a quantitative background? </strong>It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a <strong>Master's degree</strong>, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.</p> <p><strong>Does the program include rotations?</strong> No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.</p> <p><strong>In what language should I apply?</strong> English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)</p> <p><strong>What are the long-term opportunities after the program? </strong>This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. </p> <p>Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.</p> <p> </p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2IRqvZkJcMY?si=Z1fgP9D6WGVQcG1R" width="560" height="315"></iframe></p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: SEO Manager, EU/UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p>Europe is Quince's next growth engine. We have launched in the UK, with further European markets on the roadmap, and organic discovery is one of the biggest untapped levers we have.</p> <p>We are looking for an SEO Manager, UK & EU. You will own the organic strategy for our European markets across both traditional search and generative engines (AEO), building our European playbook.</p> <p>This is a cross-market, hands-on role with an unusual amount of ownership. Technical SEO standards and platform-level architecture come primarily from our global SEO team in the US; you are the person who translates those foundations into a European strategy, identifies where Europe needs something different, and makes the case for it. You will work day to day with storefront, copywriting, merchandising, growth marketing, engineering and data — and you will be the main driver for organic growth in the region.</p> <p>If you want to build an organic program from the ground up in markets where the brand is still being established, this is that job.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the UK/EU SEO & AEO strategy.</strong> Build and maintain a market-level roadmap that reflects the real competitive dynamics of each country rather than a copy of the US plan. Decide where we play, which categories we go after first, and what winning looks like in each market.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely with the global SEO team.</strong> Adopt and apply global technical standards, feed European requirements into the global roadmap, and flag where a one-size-fits-all approach breaks down in-market.</li> <li><strong>Drive answer engine optimisation across Europe.</strong> Build Quince's presence in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and the surfaces that follow. Own structured data coverage, entity and brand consistency, citation-worthy content, and the measurement approach that tells us whether any of it is working.</li> <li><strong>Make localisation a search advantage, not an afterthought.</strong> Work with copywriting and localisation to ensure category, PDP and editorial content targets genuine local search demand — not translated US keywords. Build the keyword and demand research foundation for each market and turn it into briefs writers can act on.</li> <li><strong>Own international search architecture in-market.</strong> Hreflang and market targeting, URL and domain structure, canonical logic, indexation of localised catalogues, and the crawl health of each European storefront — specced and QA'd with global SEO and engineering, with you accountable for the outcome.</li> <li><strong>Shape the storefront with merchandising and site merch.</strong> Influence category taxonomy, navigation, on-site search and PLP structure so that pages serve organic discovery as well as conversion. Partner on how content is modelled in our CMS and how listing pages are built and ranked.</li> <li><strong>Work in lockstep with growth marketing.</strong> Understand where organic and paid overlap, where they cannibalise, and where organic can take load off paid spend. Bring an incrementality mindset to the way we report and invest.</li> <li><strong>Own SEO/AEO readiness for new market launches.</strong> Define the checklist, run it, and make sure every new European storefront goes live search-ready rather than being retrofitted six months later.</li> <li><strong>Measure, report and build the case for investment.</strong> Own market-level organic reporting and the quarterly narrative for European and global leadership.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Required experience</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in SEO, ideally in ecommerce, retail or consumer brands, with meaningful ownership of organic performance.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience running SEO across more than one country or language.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of technical SEO: crawl and indexation, site architecture, structured data, page performance. </li> <li>Content-led SEO experience: keyword and demand research, content strategy, briefing writers, and building category and editorial content that ranks and converts.</li> <li>Practical exposure to AEO — structured data, entity management, and a real point of view on how Quince should show up in AI-driven discovery.</li> <li>Comfortable in the data: Google Search Console, GA4, and the standard SEO toolset (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar).</li> <li>Excellent communicator in English, and effective working asynchronously with a headquarters team in another time zone.</li> <li>A bias for shipping. You are happy operating without a large team, deciding what matters most this quarter, and doing the work yourself.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Preferred</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Working proficiency in English and, preferably, a second language (e.g. German, French, or Spanish).</li> <li>Experience launching ecommerce storefronts in new countries.</li> <li>Familiarity with headless CMS and search stacks (e.g. Contentful, Algolia) and translation management platforms (e.g. Smartling).</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted tooling to produce or optimise content, metadata and structured data at scale.</li> <li>Apparel, home or lifestyle retail experience in the European market.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who you are</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>You think in systems. You would rather build a repeatable process that scales to five markets than win one category by hand.</li> <li>You are genuinely curious about how discovery is changing, and you are already testing how AI-driven search behaves in your own markets.</li> <li>You are persuasive without authority. Much of your impact comes from convincing merchandisers, writers, engineers and a global team to prioritise your work.</li> <li>You are commercially minded. You connect organic performance to revenue, not just to rankings.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with being early. Europe is not a finished operation, and you will help decide what it becomes.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3604"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3662">Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. </p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4074">Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing <a href="https://forms.gle/DpJ11jHa1WbqfUWB9">this accommodation form</a>. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4428">Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for <strong>10,000+ businesses worldwide</strong>, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, <strong>millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day</strong>.</p> <p>We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.</p> <p>We're <strong>100 people</strong>, <strong>profitable</strong>, and have raised <strong>€18M in funding</strong> (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.</p> <p>We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.</p> <p>In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.</p> <p>We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.</p> <h4>This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code</h4> <p>You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Location & work mode</span></h4> <p>Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">What you'll do</span></h4> <ul> <li>Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure</li> <li>Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow</li> <li>Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself</li> <li>Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves</li> <li>Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap</li> <li>Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it</li> <li>Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships</li> <li>Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. You drive positioning, the in-product moments, and the keynote for the big launches, with marketing and sales behind you</li> <li>Work across squads with the AI and Core PMs on the surfaces that touch each other</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">What we're looking for</span></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years experience in Product Management in B2B SaaS</li> <li>Background in Software Engineering </li> <li>A track record of shipping things people actually use</li> <li>Engineering background or strong hands-on coding experience</li> <li>Exceptional product and operational judgement</li> <li>Fluent in OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and API versioning. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus</li> <li>Shameless customer obsession</li> <li>Extreme clarity in writing and thinking</li> <li>Speed without sloppiness</li> <li>Low ego and a builder's instinct</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">What we offer</span></h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and meaningful VSOP at a profitable, growing company</li> <li>Modern Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg</li> <li>Direct work with the founders and a real seat at the product table</li> <li>A team that ships fast and doesn't drown in process</li> <li>26 days of paid vacation, plus 2 extra days off for Christmas and New Year's Eve</li> <li>Annual personal development budget for conferences, courses, books, or coaching</li> <li>Regular team events, off-sites, and the kind of culture that makes you want to be in the office</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">See how we ship</span></h4> <p>Every year we publish a Rewind: a public record of everything we built and shipped. Probably the easiest way to see what we've been up to.</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.superchat.de/superchat-rewind-2025">Superchat Rewind 2025</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.superchat.de/superchat-rewind-2024">Superchat Rewind 2024</a></li> </ul> <p><strong>We firmly believe that diversity makes companies better. We welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to send us your application!</strong></p> <p><strong>By submitting your application, you agree to our <a href="https://www.notion.so/native/f601741cb4f24d418411aa0ff86c3787?pvs=21&deepLinkOpenNewTab=true">privacy policy</a>. </strong></p> <p><strong>We look forward to your application! 🙂</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><img src="https://i.imgur.com/Uicf3C7.jpg" alt="" width="800" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Agentic Product Manager
description: About us: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. About the role: We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next. This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product. We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm . Your responsibilities will include: Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area You're a great fit if you: Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them Are energized by having a lot of ownership and working closely with smart, mission-driven teammates Are able to work on-site from our Zurich office Bonus: You have legal domain familiarity, or experience in search and knowledge management, agentic search and data retrieval, or LegalTech – or you’ve worked in/with law firms, legal departments, or regulated industries What you can look forward to: A high-impact role in shaping a product and company with huge potential The chance to work on the cutting edge of long-horizon agentic AI, applied to real-world legal work A strong, technical, and collaborative team that’s serious about building great software A culture that encourages experimentation, curiosity, and thoughtful decision-making Submit your application by October 16th. Our team will review all candidates after the closing date and reach out regarding next steps. At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit. title: Prozessmanager:in (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. title: Praktikant Management Consulting (w/m/d)
description: Wir sind scaleon. Eine strategische Beratung für Unternehmen, die nicht nur über Transformation spricht, sondern dabei hilft, sie konsequent umzusetzen. In einer Welt, in der Stillstand Rückschritt bedeutet, helfen wir Organisationen, ihre Zukunft aktiv zu gestalten – mit klarer Strategie, nachhaltigen Strukturen und einer Kultur, die Veränderung trägt. Unser Anspruch: Wir bringen Unternehmen von der Idee zur Umsetzung. Ob Strategy Execution, Organisationsentwicklung oder Skalierung – wir begleiten Führungsteams dabei, ambitionierte Ziele in messbare Erfolge zu verwandeln. Dabei denken wir analytisch, handeln pragmatisch und gestalten Veränderungen, die wirklich greifen. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das strategische Weitsicht mit echter Umsetzungskraft verbindet, bist du bei scaleon genau richtig. Hier treibst du Transformationen voran, die den Unterschied machen – für Unternehmen, Märkte und Menschen. Was Du bewirkst Du bist Teil des scaleon-Teams auf unseren Strategieprojekten und arbeitest im direktem Kontakt mit dem Top Management unserer Klient:innen. Du entwickelst Business Cases, erarbeitest umsetzungsorientierte Lösungen und kommunizierst mittels konzeptionell präziser Frameworks. Du führst Analysen und Interviews durch, bereitest Daten auf und führst Deine Erkenntnisse in aussagekräftigen Präsentationen für unsere Klient:innen zusammen. Du erarbeitest Angebote für Neukund:innen und Pitch-Präsentationen an unsere Klient:innen. Du unterstützt uns bei verschiedenen Company-Building-Aktivitäten von scaleon. Was Du mitbringst Du bringst mindestens drei Monate an Zeit mit, um Dich optimal in die Projekte einarbeiten zu können. Du begeisterst Dich für Strategieentwicklung, digitale Geschäftsmodelle, verschiedene Industrien, neue Technologien und Innovationen sowie agile Managementmethoden. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Learning-Mindset, arbeitest Dich gerne in neue Themen, Trends und Industrien ein und hast Freude daran, Dein neues Wissen mit Deinen Kolleg:innen und unseren Klient:innen zu teilen. Du bist konzeptionell und analytisch kompetent, Du vertraust gerne auf Zahlen bei der Bewertung von Sachverhalten und legst Wert auf präzise Kommunikation. Du bist Teamplayer:in, Du hast Deine Ausdauer unter Beweis gestellt – und Du bist vielfältig interessiert. Du hast einen wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen, naturwissenschaftlichen oder technischen Bachelorabschluss von einer Universität von hoher akademischer Exzellenz mit sehr guten Noten. Du beherrschst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch min. auf C1-Niveau. Eine weitere Fremdsprache ist ein Plus. In allen Sprachen kommunizierst Du offen, parkettsicher, verbindlich und humorvoll. Du siehst das große Ganze, baust eine Firma mit uns auf und lernst, wie wir eine Beratungsbrand skalieren. Du baust Dein Netzwerk aus, bei Gründer:innen, Investor:innen und Top Management führender Unternehmen. Wir legen großen Wert auf gezielte Mitarbeiterentwicklung, regelmäßiges Training und Mentoring sowie Feedback auf Augenhöhe als Ergänzung zu intensivem Training on-the-Job. Wir wollen langfristig mit Dir arbeiten. Wir leben eine flache Organisation, arbeiten hybrid, haben flexible Arbeitszeiten und ermöglichen unter anderem mit 30 Urlaubstagen eine gute Balance zwischen Job, Sport und Privatleben. Wir bieten eine attraktive Vergütung entsprechend dem Standard führender Strategieberatungen. Wir haben ein modernes, helles Büro am Kurfürstendamm im Herzen Berlins. Wer wir sind Unsere Gründer sind erfahrene Unternehmer, Führungskräfte und Berater mit digitalem Background. Dies spiegelt sich in unserer pragmatischen Arbeitsweise wider. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description: Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren. Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. Deine Mission bei Foodji: (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. title: Hackers wanted – Software Engineers
description: ABOUT OUR COMPANY We are an engineering organization. Our mission is to “Ship great software” and build custom, large-scale software platforms on time, on budget, on target and on quality. In over two decades, we have never failed to deliver what we promised. 85% of our members are software engineers with a background in computer science, physics or mathematics, many also with a strong background in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. freiheit.com technologies was founded in Hamburg in the midst of the first internet boom in the last millennium in 1999. Since then, we’ve been building custom software platforms and helping our clients to create their future business models based on software. For over a quarter of a century, we have been working for the "Who's Who" of German and European industry and business. Retail, automotive, e-commerce, healthcare and more. Our large-scale software platforms are used by millions of users every day. Each product has a business-critical, strategic relevance for our clients. Together we make “mission impossible” possible. We are a team of 300+ members with people from all over the world. In our engineering hubs in Hamburg and Lisbon we come together to create things that no one has built before. Our teams work data-driven to constantly optimize their own productivity by removing friction from their work. Each member takes on end-to-end responsibility for their work. To be successful, you need to be productive. To be productive, you need to be efficient and effective. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ABOUT THE JOB Your responsibility : From day one, you’ll own your stories and take end-to-end responsibility for your tasks. Your team: You'll work in a small team of no more than five full-stack engineers. Like this, our teams are more efficient and can move fast. Your work: You’ll be involved in the entire software engineering lifecycle of your project - from product requirements and design to testing, deployment and operations. You’ll see how people actually use what you build and continuously improve it based on user feedback and real usage data. Your projects: We partner with clients across all industries who trust us with their most challenging software problems. We take full ownership from the first idea to the final roll-out. You’re not joining a client team as an extra pair of hands - you’re part of the team responsible for solving the problem. We don’t do body leasing. Your impact: You will contribute to some of the largest, business-critical and most demanding software projects in Europe. Your perspective: No matter your experience, everyone starts as a newbie and passes through all of our engineering levels. From owning small to medium feature sets to being responsible for the whole codebase. Here you can learn how to build and run large-scale software systems – and grow into a full-stack software engineer. Your community: You’ll work with smart, like-minded people who care about what they do and the people around them. With over 300 people across our Hamburg and Lisbon hubs, we work hard, support each other, and make sure to create a work environment where you can become the best version of yourself. We are a company for engineers by engineers. Most of your time is spent solving problems with like-minded people, writing software and working together with your team in our beautiful offices in the heart of Hamburg & Lisbon. We expect a lot. It's not easy. But we guarantee you it will be fun. ABOUT YOU Qualifications: A degree: Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a closely related field. Problem solving: We hire our members for their problem-solving abilities, not specific programming languages. We value strong engineering fundamentals, analytical thinking, and the ability to turn complex ideas into working code. We believe: if you know how to code, debug, and solve complex problems, you can learn any language. We hire smart engineers, not language specialists. A genuine curiosity for programming: Whether through interesting pet projects, hackathons, competitive programming. A habit of stepping outside your comfort zone: Whether through competitive tutoring, scholarships, or even competitive sports, anything else where you pushed yourself and grew from it. Bonus skills or interests: Algorithms and data structures, understanding time & space complexity Experience in Go, Kotlin, TypeScript or JavaScript Experience in front end development, like ReactJS, Angular, Vue or Flutter/Dart Functional programming with Common Lisp, Clojure or Haskell Experience working with distributed systems in the Cloud Experience in Machine Learning and Data Science OUR HIRING PROCESS From reviewing your CV to the final hire, its engineers who are in charge of the recruiting process. Your first interview will be conducted by one of our engineers. No recruiters, no script reading. You’ll talk directly with the engineers you’ll be building alongside, so we can dive straight into real technical problems and our ways of working. ABOUT OUR COMMUNITY If you ask anyone why they work here, it's pretty likely that they will say “because of the people” and “because I've never learned so much in my life”. We believe that productive people are happy people. In our engineering hubs in Hamburg and Lisbon, you will meet people from all over the world. Here you have the opportunity to work with intelligent people on interesting tasks and complete projects from idea to operations – end-to-end. Becoming a well-rounded professional in your field of expertise is a long journey that takes many years of hard work and learning. Being a member of our company will ask a lot of you and no one can do the work for you. Our company is a place where you can become the best version of yourself. ***We don’t provide remote-only positions. We work in the office five days a week. WANT TO JOIN US? Send us your complete application (CV) via our applicant portal. If you have any questions about your application or the application process, please contact Bianca Mioc personally at +49 40/890584-0.
