title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Our Opportunity Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate. Your Mission As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver. You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath. You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo. Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties. Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome What you'll own Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver. Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact. Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am. Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access. Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable. Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure. Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job. What success looks like You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use. Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why. You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it. You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you. You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how. What it takes You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement. You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast. You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows. You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy. You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration. You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem. You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers. You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them. Bonus: AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC. LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows. Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning. Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it. Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard. Why Predium? Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit. Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product. Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both. Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create. Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week. 30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description: The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production. This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field. Your role and responsibilities You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams. Build the platform Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters. Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions. Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment. Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations. Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services. Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior . Run what you build Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. title: Senior Software Engineer, Understanding
description: <div class="content-intro"><div><span id="m_8220454926977230902gmail-docs-internal-guid-9a9f34f4-7fff-014a-c97c-98ca90610a47">Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.</span></div> <div> </div></div><p>Algolia was built to help users deliver an intuitive search-as-you-type experience on their websites and mobile apps. We provide a search API used by thousands of customers in more than 100 countries. Billions of search queries are answered every month thanks to the code we push into production every day.</p> <p><strong>Join the AI Search Group: Enhancing Core Search Capabilities</strong></p> <p>The Relevance Group is dedicated to advancing the core search experience by improving both pre-query relevance (Understanding) and post-query relevance (Re-Ranking). We're responsible for key customer-facing features like Query Suggestions, Dynamic Synonym Suggestions, AI Re-Ranking, and Query Categorization. We’re looking for problem solvers with an entrepreneurial mindset—people who focus on outcomes and use data to drive decisions. If you're passionate about optimizing search relevance and applying AI thoughtfully to achieve measurable results for customers, we'd love to hear from you!</p> <p>The team is composed of engineers, with different skill sets and backgrounds. Your experience, your knowledge and your perspective will add to this diversity and help the team deliver products that make a difference.</p> <h3><strong>YOU WILL:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Be a key contributor to the design and development of ranking & understanding features</li> <li>Collaborate with a team that includes a variety of roles, ranging from front-end developers to machine learning specialists.</li> <li>Be responsible for the quality and soundness of our pipelines</li> </ul> <h3><strong>YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing and operating pipelines in production</li> <li>Experience working with large datasets and high traffic</li> <li>An interest in solving Ranking challenges</li> <li>Experience in building and maintaining API services</li> <li>Rigor in high code quality, automated testing, and other engineering best practices</li> <li>Experience using one of the major cloud providers (GCP, AWS or Azure)</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> </ul> <h3><strong>NICE TO HAVE:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience operating AI models in production environments</li> <li>Experience in Go or Python</li> <li>Experience in Kubernetes</li> <li>Sensitivity to data driven decision making, and exploring datasets with SQL</li> <li>Sensitivity to end user experience</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>The annual base salary compensation range for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€67.500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€94.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:</strong></p> <p>Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. title: Customer Solutions Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p data-path-to-node="1"><strong>Official Title - Center of Excellence Engineer</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1"><strong>Available Locations: Bengaluru, India</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2"><strong>About the Role:-</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2">As a Center of Excellence Engineer (Customer Solutions Engineer), you will provide technical guidance to Cloudflare customers. You are a Cloudflare product expert and will leverage your knowledge to ensure our customers understand and utilize the Cloudflare platform to its fullest extent. You will be collaborating with CEs, AEs, Support and other internal teams to ensure no customer falls through the cracks.</p> <p data-path-to-node="3"><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="4">Customer Onboarding and Deployment Readiness: Own the end-to-end technical onboarding experience for assigned customers post-provision. Lead structured onboarding calls, guide customers to configure initial Cloudflare settings (e.g., DNS records, SSL/TLS modes, WAF rules, Zero Trust policies), and validate that traffic is behaving as expected before the customer is declared live. Guide customers through onboarding and implementation runbooks and identify when an engagement requires escalation to the appropriate Cloudflare team. Troubleshoot common onboarding issues including DNS resolution failures, SSL/TLS certificate errors, caching misconfigurations, and authentication failures.</li> <li data-path-to-node="5">Cloudflare Configuration Guidance: Guide customers through Cloudflare configuration steps for applicable platform capabilities, including DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN, Application Security, Zero Trust/SASE, Network Services, and other Cloudflare products as assigned. Help customers understand configuration options, operational best practices, and standard deployment patterns.</li> <li data-path-to-node="6">Customer Technical Guidance and Enablement: Deliver standardized customer guidance sessions, technical walkthroughs, workshops, bootcamps, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical sessions covering Cloudflare product specific best practices, migration procedures, and post-deployment administration. Explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.</li> <li data-path-to-node="7">Documentation and Engagement Hygiene: Produce and maintain clear technical and operational artifacts, including call summaries, action item trackers, onboarding plans, runbooks, and handoff materials. Keep relevant internal systems updated after customer touchpoints and maintain high-quality documentation for continuity across teams.</li> <li data-path-to-node="8">Cross-Functional Coordination and Escalation Management: Coordinate with Cloudflare Customer Engineering, Support, Product, Engineering, Account, and other internal teams to route complex technical issues, document blockers, support escalations, and maintain continuity of customer outcomes.</li> <li data-path-to-node="9">Operational Improvement and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to reusable templates, procedures, technical guides, internal knowledge articles, automation scripts, AI-assisted workflows, and process improvements that improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of customer onboarding and customer engineering activities.</li> <li data-path-to-node="10">Technical Breadth and Continuous Development: Build and maintain working knowledge across Cloudflare product foundations, including Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services, at a depth appropriate to onboarding, adoption, troubleshooting, and technical advisory scenarios. Stay current on Cloudflare product releases, internal process updates, and relevant certifications. Be familiar with and leverage AI technology available to you to create new and innovative tools to support your work.</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="11"><strong>Minimum Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="12"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,0,0">5-12 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Engineer, Technical Support, Implementation Engineer, Onboarding Engineer, Sales/Systems Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or NOC/SOC analyst or equivalent hands-on technical experience managing customer deployments.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,1,0">Cloudflare product foundations: working knowledge of Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,2,0">Networking fundamentals: understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, CIDR, NAT, and BGP.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,3,0">Web security basics: familiarity with OWASP, WAF rules, OAuth, SAML, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,4,0">Configuration and integration: hands-on experience with the Cloudflare Dashboard, and comfort with Terraform, API-based configurations, or identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, and SAML/OIDC integrations.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,5,0">Observability: ability to read and interpret Security Events, Logs, cURL outputs, and HAR files; awareness of common causes of 5xx/4xx errors post-onboarding.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,6,0">Scripting and APIs: ability to read and debug REST API calls; basic proficiency with Python and Bash.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="13"><strong>Working Style:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="14"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,0,0">Customer empathy: explains technical concepts without jargon; calms frustrated customers.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,0,0">Structured communication: clear agendas, concise summaries, documented next steps.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,2,0">Bias for action: progresses onboarding rather than waiting; knows when to escalate appropriately.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,3,0">Curiosity: digs into why something works and learns unfamiliar Cloudflare products quickly.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,4,0">Resilience: handles ambiguity, incomplete requirements, and changing priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,5,0">Coachability: accepts feedback and improves from every onboarding engagement.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,6,0">Time management: juggles a portfolio of onboarding customers and meets committed timelines.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="15"><strong>Communication: </strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="15">Strong written and verbal communication skills. title: Backend Engineer - Mission Operations Services
description: Loft Orbital is looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Mission Operations Services (MOS) team. You’ll work across multiple satellite platforms and collaborate closely with backend, flight software, embedded systems, test, and satellite operations teams. Collaborate with flight software, embedded software, integration and test, and space infrastructure teams to integrate new satellite buses and capabilities into Cockpit. Support internal users of Cockpit (operators, test engineers, solutions engineers) by improving APIs, workflows, and debugging tools. Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies and supporting real‑time incident response when needed. Strong database fundamentals and practical experience (e.g., Postgres, time‑series DBs). Exposure to Kubernetes in production. Familiarity with InfluxDB / TimescaleDB or other time‑series systems. Background in mission‑critical, distributed, or real‑time systems (space or otherwise). title: Senior Revenue Operations Support Manager, Singapore
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>Available Location: Singapore</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Revenue Operations Support Manager to join our Revenue Operations Support team. This position will be based out of Singapore and assist our APAC region. You will play a crucial role in managing our background operations utilizing our Salesforce and CLM systems in support of internal stakeholders.  You will be engaged in projects to enhance current processes as well as suggest improvements to existing processes.  You’ll drive operational excellence and ensure that actions are aligned with company policies and processes.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Directly support sales and customer success by resolving tickets related to sales process and systems</li> <li>Independently review requests and troubleshoot to understand technical challenges, define root causes, and resolve problems.</li> <li>Verifying data accuracy of sales orders</li> <li>Effectively liaise between Sales, Customer Success, Contracts, Pricing and Finance to resolve issues for the sales team</li> <li>Follow documentation to complete ongoing tasks, identify areas for process improvement, create documentation for new tasks, and train new team members to complete ongoing tasks</li> <li>Execute existing tests and write new test scenarios to complete user acceptance testing of changes related to salesforce</li> <li>Own projects to roll out operational support for new initiatives - generate documentation, train operations teammates, and work cross functionally to make post-launch improvements</li> <li>Able to lead and develop operational projects which enhance processing speed and efficiency</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5-10 years of relevant experience in a sales operations role</li> <li>Experience as a user of Salesforce within quote to cash business processes</li> <li>Proficient in Salesforce skills needed to complete daily troubleshooting, ticket resolution and projects.</li> <li>You enjoy taking initiative and making suggestions for improvements</li> <li>Detail oriented with high capability for detecting inconsistencies.</li> <li>Proficient with Excel/Google Sheets</li> <li>Strong time management skills, as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Strong work ethic and organizational skills</li> <li>Experience at SaaS company preferred</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership. We're looking for a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our high-impact team Orion – Supply Division and help us shape the future of mobility operations. Our team owns a critical product at the heart of the Flix ecosystem — optimizing how Flix coordinates with Mobility Partners to keep millions of passengers moving across the globe. We maintain and continuously evolve a mature, stable product while simultaneously pushing it forward — tackling complex architectural challenges, reducing manual processes, and exploring AI-driven solutions. You'll take real ownership, contributing not just to code, but to product and technical decisions that directly impact the business. If you enjoy working in a collaborative, self-organized team where engineers have a genuine voice, and you're excited about solving complex problems at scale — this might be the right next step for you. Our tech stack: Backend development: Java, Spring / Spring Boot, Kafka Databases: MongoDB (DocumentDB), MySQL / Postgres (RDS), Redis (Elasticache) Cloud services: AWS, S3 DevOps / Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, Gitlab CI, Terraform Additional tools and technologies: Microservices architecture, Event-driven systems, Distributed systems design and implementation About the Role You'll collaborate with a distributed, self-organized, cross-functional team, taking full ownership of the development process and technical decisions You'll have the opportunity to design new products from the ground up while continuously improving existing ones, with room to explore and implement cutting-edge technologies Drive the development process in an Agile environment, placing our users at the center of each solution you and your team create Lead technical decisions not just within your team, but across teams, improving technical excellence through collaboration and lateral leadership Help define and deliver products that optimize the coordination between Flix and Mobility Partners, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual tasks Be part of a team building a critical product within the Flix ecosystem—solving complex challenges due to product's diverse user base and Flix's global presence About You 6+ years of experience as a Software Java and/or Kotlin Engineer, with knowledge of distributed systems, including Spring/Spring Boot, Kafka, MySQL/Postgres, Redis, MongoDB and S3 Willingness to work with both Java (for existing products) and Kotlin (for new ones) Experience in Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career Why join Flix? At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey! title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer. As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich . What you'll be doing In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth. Day-to-day in this role you'll: Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing. Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty. Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt. Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives. Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process. Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches. Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale. Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach. Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team. Our humble expectations You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers. You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature. You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides. You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams. You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact. You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail. You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions. You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. What we offer This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch. You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business. You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact. Next steps If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you. After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach. Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Senior/ Expert Relationship Manager (w/m/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About The Company</strong></p> <p>GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.</p></div><div class="job"> <h3><strong>Über die Rolle:</strong> </h3> <p>Als  Senior / Expert Relationship Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Entwicklung und den erfolgreichen Abschluss von Immobilienprojekten. Du steuerst komplexe Projektchancen von der ersten Qualifizierung über die Angebots- und Verhandlungsphase bis hin zum Vertragsabschluss und arbeitest dabei eng mit Projektentwicklern, Wohnungsunternehmen, Investoren, Kommunen und weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen. <br>Mit deinem Verständnis für Projektentwicklung, Baurecht, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Entscheidungsprozesse in der Immobilienbranche bewertest du Chancen, identifizierst Risiken und führst Kunden sicher durch den gesamten Entwicklungs- und Vergabeprozess. Dabei koordinierst du interdisziplinäre Teams, schaffst Klarheit für alle Beteiligten und sorgst für belastbare kommerzielle Entscheidungen. </p> <h3>Deine Aufgaben:</h3> <ul> <li>Übernahme qualifizierter Projektchancen vom Prospecting Team und Verantwortung für deren strategische Entwicklung bis zum Vertragsabschluss. </li> <li>Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Validierung des Business Cases sowie die Vorbereitung kommerzieller Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Management und Kunden. </li> <li>Aufbau und Management komplexer Stakeholder-Netzwerke auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführungsebene. </li> <li>Eigenständige Führung kommerzieller Verhandlungen sowie Koordination relevanter interner Stakeholder aus Legal, Finance, Technical Sales und Delivery </li> <li>Analyse von Projektpotenzialen hinsichtlich Wirtschaftlichkeit, Baurecht, Genehmigungsfähigkeit, Risiken und strategischem Fit </li> <li>Entwicklung von Account- und Opportunity-Strategien inklusive Stakeholder-Management, Pipeline-Steuerung und Forecasting </li> <li>Sicherstellung einer exzellenten Customer Journey und professionelles Management von Kundenerwartungen </li> <li>Fachliche Steuerung cross-funktionaler Projektteams und aktive Mitgestaltung von Best Practices im Relationship Management </li> <li>Unterstützung unseres Business Process Managers bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung effizienter Prozesse im Relationship Management </li> </ul> <h3> <strong>Über dich:</strong> </h3> <ul> <li>Mindestens 5 Jahre (Senior) bzw. mindestens 7 Jahre (Expert) einschlägige Erfahrung in der Immobilienprojektentwicklung, im Development Management, Business Development, Solution Sales oder einem vergleichbaren B2B-Umfeld der Immobilienwirtschaft </li> <li>Idealerweise Erfahrung bei einem Projektentwickler, Bauträger, Wohnungsunternehmen, Generalunternehmer oder Bestandshalter </li> <li>Fundiertes Verständnis der Entwicklung von Immobilienprojekten – von Grundstück, Planungs- und Baurecht über Wirtschaftlichkeit und Finanzierung bis zur Umsetzung </li> <li>Erfahrung in der Führung komplexer Vertragsverhandlungen sowie im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Kunden und Entscheidungsträgern </li> <li>Fähigkeit, Business Cases, Projektrisiken und Investitionsentscheidungen sicher zu bewerten und daraus belastbare Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten </li> <li>Ausgeprägtes kommerzielles Verständnis, Verhandlungsgeschick und ein sicheres Gespür für den Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen </li> <li>Strukturierte, proaktive Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch in komplexen Projektsituationen Klarheit und Orientierung zu schaffen </li> <li>Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Was wir bieten:</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="1" title: Staff Software Engineer – Network Automation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Role Overview:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help shape and build the next generation of our network automation platforms.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our challenge is one of scale, complexity and criticality. We operate a massive global network supporting PlayStation Network, spanning more than 40 interconnection locations and 20+ data centres worldwide. Operating infrastructure at this scale safely and efficiently requires us to move beyond specialist-driven workflows and individual automation tools toward reliable, declarative software platforms.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will help make that transition. You will work on software that turns complex network and infrastructure operations into reliable, API-driven and increasingly self-service capabilities. This includes building control-plane services, declarative APIs and intent-based controllers that manage production infrastructure safely and consistently across our global footprint.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a Staff-level engineering role with significant technical influence. You will combine hands-on engineering with setting technical direction: defining architectures, solving complex cross-system and distributed-systems problems, writing designs, driving alignment with senior engineers and architects, and mentoring engineers across the team.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Your work will directly influence how one of the world's largest gaming networks is operated and automated, while establishing engineering patterns and platforms that can be reused across multiple network domains and services.</span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Provide technical leadership and architectural direction for network automation and infrastructure control platforms, treating the self-service network API as a product by working with users and partner teams to define outcomes, establish clear expectations for API behavior and reliability, align on team responsibilities, and ensure those commitments are met.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Use domain-driven design with network experts, software engineers and API consumers to establish shared language and bounded contexts, then turn those agreements into versioned, testable contracts.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Design and build APIs, services, controllers and reconciliation workflows that manage production infrastructure safely at scale.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Build on the Kubernetes API, including custom resources and control loops that continuously converge actual state toward declared intent.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the operational Kubernetes path: CRD rollout, RBAC and admission, controller health, Helm packaging, deployment drift and incident diagnosis.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Design distributed workflows that operate correctly under eventual consistency, at-least-once delivery, concurrent writes and partial failure, with idempotency and safe recovery as fundamental properties.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Design stable APIs, schemas and data models used across team boundaries, including versioning and backwards compatibility.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop patterns for multi-tenant infrastructure platforms, including tenant isolation, authorization, policy enforcement and safe automation boundaries.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Establish strong approaches to testing, observability and change safety for software that changes live infrastructure.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Improve software delivery practices through automated CI gates, versioned artifacts, controlled promotion, and safe deployment and recovery strategies.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Lead complex migrations and modernization of existing automation, services and data models, evaluating when components should be evolved, replaced or rewritten, and ensuring safe coexistence, behavioral compatibility and retirement of legacy paths.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Drive technical alignment across software engineering, networking, operations and architecture teams; lead decisions within your area of accountability, contribute constructively to decisions owned by others, and make technology choices based on long-term company and product value.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Mentor engineers, lead technical and design reviews, and raise software engineering standards across the wider organization.</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Must have</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Deep expertise in a backend language such as Python, Go, Rust or Java, including asynchronous concurrency, static typing, data modelling and validation, API development, packaging and tooling.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators, including custom resources and reconciliation/control-loop patterns.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong experience building event-driven distributed systems, particularly eventual consistency, at-least-once delivery, idempotency, optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience designing and building self-service, multi-tenant platforms, including tenant isolation, policy and access control.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong API and schema design skills, including versioning and schema evolution for interfaces consumed by other teams and systems.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Demonstrated technical leadership across team boundaries, including driving architectural designs, building agreement among senior technical stakeholders and mentoring other engineers.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A track record of taking ambiguous, technically complex problems from architecture through to reliable production systems that manage large-scale infrastructure, such as networks, compute or cloud resources.</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Nice to have</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Networking fundamentals, particularly BGP, IP fabrics and VXLAN/EVPN/L3VPN.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Working knowledge of Go, sufficient to understand and contribute to adjacent services and controllers.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience designing testing and observability strategies for production infrastructure automation, including systems and backends that cannot be fully reproduced in CI.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience with graph databases, or with source-of-truth systems that model infrastructure and its relationships.</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>The impact</strong></span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will help establish the architecture and engineering practices behind a new generation of network automation, moving from individual scripts and specialist-driven workflows toward declarative, model-driven and reliable platforms.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">At Staff level, your impact is expected to extend beyond the code you personally deliver. You will help shape the APIs and designs other teams build on, develop other engineers, and establish technical patterns that can be reused across multiple network domains and services.</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p class="p1">Please refer to our <a href="https://www.playstation.com/legal/careers-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p><em>Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy, Intern
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware. The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one. This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes. What You'll Work On Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities. Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather. Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer. Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts. Test your work on physical robots, and join site visits to see how the system behaves in real operating conditions. Apply solid engineering practices: code review, version control, reproducible experiments and clear documentation. Who We're Looking For We're looking for a strong robotics student who wants to see their work run on real robots, not only in simulation. You don't need every item below, but you should meet the core requirements and bring depth in at least one area of the autonomy stack. You'll join a small team that moves fast, expects ownership, and holds work to the standard of running on live customer sites. Your Background Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD, or completed a Master's degree within the last year, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field. Demonstrated depth in at least one of perception, localisation and state estimation, or motion planning and navigation, through a thesis, research or a substantial project. Strong coding skills in Python. Hands-on experience with ROS 2. Comfortable using Linux, Docker and Git in your workflows. Nice to Have Experience working with physical robots, ideally mobile or legged. Experience with lidar or camera processing, SLAM, or sensor fusion. Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo or MuJoCo. Publications or competition results in robotics (ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL). What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)
description: About us Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible. As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale. About the role Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave. As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams. Responsibilities Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle About you 6+ years in product management Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English Nice to have Document or file-processing products A utility business with a strong free tier Experience with high-volume consumer tools Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate. Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact! Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference. Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values . Our Benefits 🌍 You get to impact the way over 60 million people get work done every month. 🚀 Push boundaries and dare to fail - that’s how we learn! 💻 Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, and meet your team occasionally to work together and strengthen the team bond. 🏝️ 30 vacation days - yep, you read that right - that you can take whenever you need them. 🧳 Need a long break? We offer sabbatical leave to employees who’ve been with us for over 2 years. 👶 16 weeks parental leave - 100% of your salary - for all new parents 🐶 Don’t leave your four-legged friends at home, our offices are pet-friendly 📚 A personal development budget of up to 2,000 CHF every year, plus days off for courses or training. 🤓 Internal knowledge sharing and external coaching options during your working hours to boost both your hard and soft skills. 👩‍💻 Hack days to challenge you and your team, plus build amazing things. 🍻 BBQs, game nights, meetups in the Swiss Alps, or in kayaks on Lake Zurich—we’re serious about great coffee, karaoke, and Mario Kart, too! How to Apply Please apply using the form below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred. Hiring policy Smallpdf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe our strength comes from a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, identities, perspectives, and lived experiences. We welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, abilities, orientations, and life paths. You’ll also have the option to share your pronouns and answer an anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply. This information is completely voluntary, but it helps us stay accountable in building an inclusive and equitable hiring process. We use AI thoughtfully in our day-to-day work, but we value human curiosity, creativity, and integrity above all. We’re excited to meet candidates who bring genuine expertise, real stories, and authentic experience to the table. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against. 2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job. If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold. 1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus. 2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer. 3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter. 4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus. Why us? Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate. No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title. We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one. Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP). Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible. Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together. Process Expectations. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going. Build session. title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Mercanis bist du der zentrale Umsatztreiber für unser bestehendes Kundenportfolio im gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise-Segment. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Vertriebs-Restrukturierung trennen wir "Hunting" und "Farming" konsequent: Du übernimmst die volle Vertriebs- und Deal-Verantwortung für ein exklusives Territory von ca. 60–70 bestehenden Accounts. Deine Mission: Du identifizierst ungenutzte Cross- und Upsell-Potenziale, navigierst souverän durch komplexe C-Level-Buying-Center, steuerst vielschichtige Deal-Zyklen bis zum Verhandlungsabschluss und maximierst so nachhaltig unsere Net Revenue Retention (NRR). Wenn du ein tiefes Verständnis für B2B-SaaS-Vertriebsmethodiken mitbringst und Bestandskunden nicht nur betreuen, sondern durch echten Mehrwert strategisch ausbauen willst, ist dies deine perfekte Gelegenheit. Dein Aufgabenbereich Expansion & ARR-Wachstum: Du steuerst den gesamten Verkaufszyklus für Upsell-, Cross-Sell- und Modul-Erweiterungen in einem Portfolio von ca. 60–70 Bestandskunden und triffst deine eigenen Quota-Ziele. Pipeline-Generierung im Bestand: Du analysierst deine Accounts eigenständig auf White Spots, identifizierst neue Anwendungsfälle im Bereich Einkauf & Supply Chain Management und generierst aktiv qualifizierte Expansion-Pipeline. Strategisches Closing & C-Level Selling: Du navigierst komplexe Buying Center (CPO, CFO, IT-Leitung), baust Belieber- & Champion-Netzwerke auf Executive-Ebene auf und führst kommerzielle Verhandlungen (Preisgestaltung, Lizenzerweiterungen, Vertragsverlängerungen) eigenständig zum Abschluss. Executive Relationship & Account Planning: Du erstellst strategische Account-Pläne für deine Top-Kunden, führst regelmäßige Business Reviews (QBRs) auf C-Level durch und positionierst Mercanis als unverzichtbaren Software-Partner. Set clear entry and exit criteria and go-live readiness checks, and track delivery health: time to first value, go-live quality, and customer satisfaction. Start with a small, carefully selected group of partner practitioners and grow capacity as quality is proven. Co-create onboarding, training, certification, and train-the-trainer programs so partners can develop their own Dust experts.
