title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth (f/m/x)
description: <h2 class="ql-header-2"><strong>About the role: What's in the <span class="Highlight ht8de9e54e-80f2-4c83-a0bc-8306711420fe">Box</span></strong></h2> <p>The <strong>Growth Alliance</strong> powers <span class="Highlight ht8de9e54e-80f2-4c83-a0bc-8306711420fe">HelloFresh</span>’s marketing engine, from media investment and in-channel optimization, to the conversion funnel, to how and when we communicate with customers. As a <strong>Senior Data Scientist</strong>, you will design and ship statistical and machine learning models that turn data from experiments, campaigns, and customer behavior into decisions that directly move the business: how we spend our marketing budget, how we convert visitors into customers, and how we personalize every touchpoint along the way.</p> <p>You’ll join one of several teams within the alliance, spanning marketing measurement and attribution, channel optimisation, funnel optimisation and decisioning on customer communications and messaging. Across all of these topics, the through line is the same: rigorous modeling, close collaboration with engineering and marketing stakeholders, and a bias toward shipping models that work in production, not just in a notebook.</p> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a curious, pragmatic problem solver who relentlessly prioritizes based on impact, is comfortable with statistical uncertainty, and can translate a fuzzy business question into a concrete, testable model.</p> <p>At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do: The Recipe</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and take ownership of statistical and machine learning models, from data collection through to production, closely aligning the approach with non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Collaborate within cross-functional teams (engineering, product, marketing) to translate business objectives into concrete, data-driven strategies.</li> <li>Experimentation: design tests, define success metrics and guardrails, and interpret results while accounting for statistical uncertainty, noise, and bias.</li> <li>Continuously iterate and refine your technical approach, monitor model performance, data reliability, and drift once in production.</li> <li>Retrieve, manipulate, and analyze large, heterogeneous datasets, and build the data pipelines your models depend on.</li> <li>Think beyond the immediate ask to find new ways to improve the data products delivered to stakeholders.</li> <li>As a senior member of the team, jump in to help solve problems as they arise, and support and coach more junior data scientists.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring: The Ingredients </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven track record of scientific work through a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in statistics, physics, economics, mathematics, data science, or a related quantitative field.</li> <li>3+ years of professional experience as a (senior) data scientist or in a related quantitative role, ideally in e-commerce, marketing, or a comparably high-traffic, consumer-facing environment.</li> <li>Strong marketing and/or growth domain knowledge, with experience applying statistical models such as regressors and classifiers, and interpreting experiment results under real-world uncertainty.</li> <li>Fluency in Python and its scientific stack (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib); comfortable retrieving and analyzing data with SQL. Experience with Databricks/Spark is a plus.</li> <li>Familiarity with software engineering practices and tools (Git, Docker, AWS or similar cloud environments).</li> <li>Comfortable using recent Gen AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) to design and build solutions in a structured and pragmatic manner.</li> <li>A critical thinker and creative problem solver who is comfortable proposing and prioritizing multiple solutions based on effort and likely impact.</li> <li>A collaborative team player with exceptional communication skills, able to work with stakeholders from different backgrounds in an international environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have (domain specific), if you find yourself in one of the below, it’s a huge plus!</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Measurement & attribution:</strong> experience with media mix models, attribution modeling, or incrementality measurement; Bayesian forecasting and estimating model uncertainty.</li> <li><strong>Search or Social channel optimization:</strong> experience with the Google/Meta ecosystem or other paid channels, forecasting algorithms, portfolio optimization, or Vector Autoregression.</li> <li><strong>Conversion & personalization:</strong> experience building decisioning or recommendation models that run in production behind high-traffic conversion funnels; customer segmentation and behavioral data.</li> <li><strong>Messaging & send decisioning:</strong> direct experience with reinforcement learning or contextual bandits (e.g. Thompson Sampling, epsilon-greedy), off-policy/counterfactual evaluation, or CRM and marketing decisioning use cases.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer: The Toppings</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Global collaboration at scale:</strong> Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.</li> <li><strong>Technology with real-world impact:</strong> Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.</li> <li><strong>Technical/Product/Design leadership:</strong> Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.</li> <li><strong>End-to-end development/delivery:</strong> Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Are you the missing ingredient?</strong> If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.</p> <p>#DATA</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Director, Paid Strategy (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Global Paid Marketing owns how HelloFresh Group buys customers across its portfolio of brands and markets. The team spans Paid Social, Paid Search, Display & Video, Partnerships & Affiliates, Creative Strategy and the Creators program, and steers one of the largest acquisition budgets in direct-to-consumer. We are rebuilding the organization around fewer, stronger channel leaders and an AI-first way of working, and this role is central to making that model run.</p> <p>We are looking for an Associate Director of Paid Strategy to own the strategy, planning and operating backbone of Global Paid Marketing. Reporting to the Head of Global Paid Marketing, you will set how the paid portfolio plans its budget, runs its business reviews and prioritizes and delivers its biggest bets.</p> <p>Channel leaders own their numbers. You own the system around them: the plan they commit to, the cadence that holds them to it, the cross-channel programs no single team owns, and the insightsthat turns many channels and dozens of entities into one clear view of the business. It is a role with unusual breadth and visibility, built for someone who wants to understand how a large paid organization is run, not just how one channel performs.</p> <p>You will work directly with the paid leadership team, with StratOps as your closest partner: StratOps sets the company-wide growth agenda and governance, and you translate it into how paid team plans, operates and reports, then bring the paid view back into that agenda. You will also partner closely with Finance, Analytics, HR and Brand. This role is primarily designed as an Individual Contributor position: ; your impact  comes from the quality of your thinking, the rigor of your follow-through and the trust you earn.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Above all, we are looking for people who will <strong>make HelloFresh</strong> <strong>better.</strong> We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.</span></p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Paid strategy and planning</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the planning cycle for the global paid portfolio: annual Business Plan, half-year budgets and monthly MBT re-forecasts, from channel-mix and entity allocation through to CAC and volume guardrails.</li> <li>Partner with StratOps and Finance so paid commitments tie to company targets, and pressure-test every submission based on run-rates and data-driven assumptions  </li> <li>Shape the multi-year paid strategy: where to invest, where to pull back, and which capabilities the organization needs to build.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operating rhythm and governance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and run the operating cadence of the paid organization: weekly and monthly business reviews, QBRs, leadership team meetings and senior leadership steerings.</li> <li>Set agendas, write or commission pre-reads, and own the decision and action log so every meeting ends with an owner and a date, and every commitment is followed through.</li> <li>Define the KPIs, targets and reporting standards that let leadership compare channels and entities on one consistent basis.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-channel programs</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the high-priority initiatives that span channels and no single team owns, such as measurement and incrementality, partner and agency consolidation, and AI adoption across the team.</li> <li>Run them with clear scope, milestones and owners, and escalate early when they drift.</li> <li>Conduct and synthesize ad hoc strategic analysis to support paid leadership with decision marking or problem solving</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Insight and executive communication</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Turn performance across channels and entities into a single, narrative for senior leadership: CMO updates, QBRs, steering decks and budget reviews.</li> <li>Ensure high quality and consistent deliverable from the Paid team to Leadership to enable fast and informed decision making  </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Organization and capability planning</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Support org design, headcount and people-cost planning for Global Paid Marketing, working with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition.</li> <li>Track priority hiring and internal moves, and keep one source of truth for the team's structure and capacity.</li> <li>Drive knowledge transfer and best-practice sharing across channels and markets.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI-enabled operations</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Use AI to automate recurring reporting, business-review preparation and forecasting, freeing leaders' time for decisions.</li> <li>Assess and introduce AI tools that improve planning, budget optimization and insight generation, and hold their output to account.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>6+ years in strategy and operations, growth strategy, management consulting or performance marketing at scale, including time close to senior decision-makers.</li> <li>A strong quantitative foundation: you can build a budget or forecast model, read an experiment, and defend a recommendation with data rather than opinion. SQL or equivalent is a plus.</li> <li>Fluency in marketing economics: CAC, payback, incrementality, and how budget, channel mix and volume trade off against each other.</li> <li>Proven ability to run complex, cross-functional programs and to influence senior peers without direct authority.</li> <li>Executive-level communication: you write crisp pre-reads, build decks that make a point on page one, and can tell leadership what they need to hear.</li> <li>Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information, including budgets, organization plans and people topics.</li> <li>Hands-on use of AI to compress real analytical or operational work, not just as a search engine.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; you bring structure where there is none and keep many threads moving at once.</li> </ul> <p>Bonus points if you have owned a planning or budget cycle end to end, worked in a multi-brand or multi-market organization, or come from a top-tier consulting or strategy program.</p> <h2><strong>What success looks like in your first year</strong></h2> <ul> <li>The paid operating cadence runs on a fixed calendar, with standard pre-reads and a decision log that leadership trusts and uses.</li> <li>The next Business Plan and half-year budget submissions go in on time, from one source of truth, with every material assumption pressure-tested.</li> <li>Two or three cross-channel programs have landed with measurable impact on CAC, volume or team productivity.</li> <li>Recurring reporting and review preparation are largely automated, and leaders spend their time on decisions rather than slides.</li> <li>Senior leadership gets one consistent, candid view of paid performance across channels and entities.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <p>Compensation & Financial Wellbeing</p> <ul> <li>You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.</li> <li>Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.</li> <li>Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.</li> </ul> <p>Health & Wellbeing</p> <ul> <li>Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.</li> <li>Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.</li> </ul> <p>Flexibility & Work-Life</p> <ul> <li>Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.</li> <li>Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.</li> <li>Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.</li> </ul> <p>Career & Development</p> <ul> <li>Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.</li> </ul> <p>Culture & Environment</p> <ul> <li>Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.</li> <li>We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Are you up for the challenge?</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days. </span></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. provisioning, configuration, and runtime operations.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Streamline Developer Workflows:</strong> Develop platform software and self-service tools that reduce operational toil, frameworks, automated testing pipelines, and self-healing tools to maintain high availability and proactively catch operational failures.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Collaborate Cross-Functionally:</strong> Partner closely with Security, Systems, and Product Engineering teams to integrate infrastructure software seamlessly across the application lifecycle.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrable experience as a Software Engineer building production software, with an emphasis on backend systems, APIs, or developer platform tools.<br><br></li> <li>Strong proficiency in modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, Java, or Rust) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and maintainable code.<br><br></li> <li>Solid understanding of software design patterns, API architecture (REST, gRPC), and data structures applied to operational tooling.<br><br></li> <li>Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and programmatically interacting with infrastructure APIs.<br><br></li> <li>Strong analytical, debugging, and system troubleshooting skills to diagnose issues across both application logic and underlying infrastructure.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience writing software that interacts with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, Docker).<br><br></li> <li>Familiarity with building robust CI/CD systems, automated integration testing, or continuous deployment tooling.<br><br></li> <li>Active contributions to open-source developer tools, CLI applications, or infrastructure platforms.<br><br></li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
description: Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen. # Weiterbildung : Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme. # Steile Lernkurve : Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder sogar kleine Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach einem Jahr eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst. Und dein Einsatz bleibt nicht unbeachtet - wir sind stolz darauf, über 90% unserer Trainees in eine Festanstellung zu übernehmen. # Arbeitsumfeld : Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. Was solltest du mitbringen? # Background : Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und möchtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können? # Leidenschaft : Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf. # Verhandlungsgeschick : Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise. # Persönlichkeit : Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer. # Was noch? Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen. Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? title: Senior Quality & Food Safety Manager (m/f/d)
description: Come and join the leading #avoexperts 🥑 Westfalia Fruit is a leading multinational supplier of fresh fruit and related value added products to global markets. Through our vertically-integrated supply chain we grow, source, ripen, pack, process and market quality avocadoes & fresh produce – 365 days a year & across the globe. With the largest avocado-growing footprint in the world, we are recognised as the leading #avoexperts , and considered as the supplier of choice to both retail & wholesale customers whom we serve from sales offices in the UK, Europe, North America, Latin America & Southern Africa. We value Inclusivity, Innovation, Quality, Integrity and Health & Safety. Together, we can create a thriving and positive work environment. We have a new opportunity for an experienced Senior Quality & Food Safety Manager to join our team in Munich, Germany on an initial 12 month contract with possibility to extend permanently. The Senior Quality & Food Safety Manager provides technical leadership for quality and food safety across the Munich operation. The role ensures IFS audit readiness and business continuity while strengthening the Quality and Food Safety Management System. Working with Operations, Supply Chain, suppliers, customers and international Quality functions, it drives effective controls, audit preparation and corrective action. Through documented processes, training and knowledge sharing, the role builds team capability and reduces reliance on individual knowledge holders. This is a senior specialist role without disciplinary management responsibility. Responsibilities include: Lead IFS certification readiness and coordinate internal, external and customer audits. Maintain and improve the Quality and Food Safety Management System. Review HACCP plans and food safety controls as products, suppliers and processes evolve. Work with Operations to strengthen hygiene, cleaning, storage and temperature controls. Ensure compliance with quality, food safety and customer requirements, supporting QS, BIO and GQB certifications. Investigate complaints and non-conformities, driving effective corrective actions. Manage supplier quality assessments, approval documentation and issue resolution. Maintain traceability and recall readiness, supporting incident investigations and product decisions. Monitor quality performance, report risks and drive continuous improvement. Train colleagues, document key processes and share expertise to strengthen team capability and business continuity. Requirements Essential Relevant degree or comparable qualification in food science, food technology, quality management or a related discipline. Several years of relevant Quality Management and Food Safety experience within the food industry, with the technical judgement to work independently at senior level. Strong practical IFS experience, including substantial involvement in certification preparation, audit delivery and closure of findings. Sound working knowledge of HACCP, food hygiene, food safety controls and Quality and Food Safety Management Systems. Experience conducting or coordinating audits, investigating non-conformities and complaints, and implementing effective corrective actions. Ability to prioritise audit and operational risks, manage competing deadlines and translate technical requirements into practical actions. Independent, structured and pragmatic working style, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Ability to influence cross-functional colleagues, communicate risks clearly and build constructive supplier and customer relationships. Fluent German and English, both written and spoken. Ability to maintain clear documentation, share technical knowledge and support colleague development and effective handovers. Desirable Previous lead responsibility for IFS certification and audits. Experience in fresh food, particularly fruit and vegetables, or comparable FMCG food operations. Practical experience supporting QS, BIO and GQB certification requirements. Formal HACCP or internal/lead auditor training relevant to food safety and quality. Experience strengthening management systems, transferring specialist knowledge or supporting an operation through an intensive audit preparation period. Experience collaborating with international Quality teams and managing supplier quality or traceability exercises. Benefits Internal English course Professional development opportunities within the company Membership in the Body & Soul gym for a small fee Office at the Munich wholesale market near the Isar Competitive salary 30 days of vacation per year Free parking Fresh fruit and coffee specialties Please note that this position does not have a specific closing date. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible as we will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis and the advert may be removed at any time. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. title: Senior Practice Leader, Developer Platform for Professional Services, APAC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Australia, Sydney</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Global Practice Leader for our product portfolio: Developer Platform, Professional services to join our growing team. title: Neuroscientist
description: Type: Full-time Location: University of Sussex, Brighton - On-site The Role Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models. We're looking for a Neuroscientist to join our Brighton research team as an independent contributor driving experiments from design through analysis. You'll design and run in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural experiments, work with large-scale neural and behavioural datasets, and partner closely with our ML team to translate what we learn about real brains and bodies into better foundation models. This is a role for someone who wants their science to feed directly into what gets built next. Responsibilities In Vivo Electrophysiology & Neural Recording Design and run in vivo electrophysiology experiments in animal models Develop and refine neural recording protocols and rigs alongside the hardware team Ensure recordings meet the quality and fidelity standards our models are trained on Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets Plan and oversee data collection sessions, in collaboration with technicians Iterate on experimental design based on data quality and downstream modelling needs Data Analysis & Computational Modelling Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets Build and apply computational models to characterise neural and behavioural dynamics Validate findings and communicate results clearly to the broader research team Neuroscience → AI Translation Partner with the ML team to translate biological findings into model design choices Help define what neurobehavioural data and features are most valuable to capture Contribute to internal research direction connecting neuroscience and foundation model development Requirements Core (essential) BSc/MSc in neuroscience, behavioural sciences, or a related field, with hands-on experimental research experience. Preferred: PhD and experience with in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural neuroscience experiments Strong data analysis skills, including experience with Python or a similar language Able to design rigorous experiments and think critically about data quality Excellent communication; comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and ML teams Valued (or willing to learn) Experience with large-scale or multi-modal neurobehavioural datasets Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals or foundation model training Experience with computational modelling of neural or behavioural data Prior work bridging neuroscience and AI/robotics research Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Systems Engineer - Data Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll help build and maintain Data Security products as a Software Engineer. These products empower customers to gain deep visibility into Cloud/SaaS security opportunities and into trends in their network traffic and product use. As an engineer on the team, you will focus on building new functionality into our APIs and distributed code while ensuring the performance and reliability of our services which ingest millions of data points each day. You’ll be joining a team of bright, knowledge-seeking engineers who are truly missionaries in solving the security and network visibility challenges for our customers.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Products are written in Go, Python, and Typescript.</li> <li>Code runs on Kubernetes, Cloudflare Workers, AWS, GCP, Azure.</li> <li>We utilize Postgres as our data store, Redis as our cache, and Kafka as our message broker.</li> <li>Our frontend is written in Typescript and React.</li> <li>For service monitoring we use Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li>For service logging we use Elasticsearch and Kibana.</li> <li>For product analytics we use Clickhouse and BigQuery. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of professional experience building and managing reliable and performant software systems at scale, preferably with technologies like: Go, Python, Postgres</li> <li>Passion for making the digital world a more secure place</li> <li>Excellent debugging and optimization skills</li> <li>Willingness, curiosity, and enthusiasm to learn new programming languages, technologies and systems</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Caring and empathy are coveted traits here!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Frontend programming experience in Typescript/Javascript</li> <li>Previous experience working with third-party API integrations</li> <li>Previous experience working on security products</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. title: Electrical Design Engineer & Machine Safety Specialist (M/F)
description: Join us in driving connectivity forward! At One Mobility Group , we bridge worlds—combining nearly a century of German automotive engineering precision with the innovation power of the globe's largest electronics and ICT manufacturer. This unique positioning makes us the strategic partner for end-to-end mobility solutions—from initial concept design to large-scale manufacturing. Our comprehensive portfolio spans the full spectrum of electrified mobility, including power distribution systems, high- and low-voltage modules, safety components, and advanced charging solutions. We specialize in integration expertise that seamlessly connects data, power, and sensing – redefining what’s possible in intelligent, connected mobility. At One Mobility , you will join a vibrant international team of 10,500 people, working together in 17 countries across Europe, Asia, North America, the Middle East, and Africa. Step into a culture where inclusivity is the foundation, where your ideas are trusted and supported, your passions are nurtured, and the spirit of collaboration is encouraged. We move fast, think differently, and empower our people to deliver breakthrough solutions. We are looking for an Electrical Design Engineer & Machine Safety Specialist (M/F) for our site located in Masevaux (68290), France. Your missions: Take the next step in your carrer within an innovative and international automotive environment : Design and update electrical schematics using SEE Electrical, as well as the associated technical documentation. Define electrical architectures, prepare bills of materials (BOMs), and draft technical specifications for suppliers. Participate in the selection and standardization of electrical components, automation systems, safety equipment, and industrial networks. Monitor electrical installations, verify wiring compliance, and support assembly, testing, and commissioning activities. Validate equipment supplied by external vendors through technical reviews, FAT/SAT procedures, and compliance checks. Perform risk assessments and define machine safety architectures in accordance with applicable standards. Conduct Performance Level (PL) calculations using SISTEMA and verify the compliance of safety functions. Contribute to CE marking activities and ensure the regulatory compliance of equipment. Support the continuous improvement of technical standards and maintain up-to-date technical documentation. Education: Bachelor’s degree (2 to 5 years of higher education) in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field. Experience: Proven experience in the electrical design of special-purpose machines or industrial equipment. Experience in managing technical projects and ensuring installation compliance. Technical Skills: Strong expertise in the design and development of electrical schematics. Good knowledge of industrial equipment, automated systems, and technical validation processes. Ability to analyze and verify the technical compliance of supplier deliverables. Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of machine safety requirements and associated regulations. Ability to ensure compliance with company standards and technical specifications. Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners. Capable of working independently while maintaining a collaborative team-oriented approach. Problem Solving: Analytical mindset and strong sense of responsibility. Ability to identify technical gaps, propose improvement solutions, and implement sustainable corrective actions while ensuring compliance with company standards. Languages: Fluency in French is required, and a good command of technical English is necessary to work effectively in an international environment. Our offer: Corporate benefits program with many attractive offers Globally operating group of companies Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes Contract type: Permanent contract Are you interested? We are looking forward to receive your application. If you have any questions in the meantime do not hesitate to contact us. title: Full time paid Internship DSU/ Stage DSU Paris
description: Introduction The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking. The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions. About this job The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations , sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks. You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals. No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered. We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026 . Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné). Your profile We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy. Suitable candidates should have: Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship. Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code. Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context. Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction. A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility. An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking , particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy. Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset. Your responsibilities Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will: Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python. Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources. Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction. Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences. Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients. Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes. Our offer We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications. Many of our interns become full-time staff at Technopolis or go on to pursue opportunities in the public and private sectors. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
description: Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation. You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management. Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees. Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure. Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments. Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress. Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit. Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1). Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking. Preferred Qualifications Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation. IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus. Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment. Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats. Experience with Jira and Confluence. Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation. title: Senior Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p><strong>Hybrid | Austin, San Francisco</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare's Senior Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineers work where Cloudflare's infrastructure meets customer impact.</p> <p>As a Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer, you will be embedded with one of Cloudflare's most strategic customers, collaborating to ensure modern cloud compute capacity is available, reliable, and ready when needed. You will guide new capacity from delivery to production, partnering with Cloudflare's data center and hardware teams to ensure systems pass validation, come online smoothly, and uphold Cloudflare's high standards.</p> <p>You will serve as a bridge connecting Cloudflare's infrastructure, hardware, and data center teams with the customer's engineering organization. You'll ensure teams work from a shared vision, clear operational roadblocks, and feed real-world insights back into how Cloudflare builds and evolves its platform.</p> <p>This role is ideal for engineers who want to:</p> <ul> <li>Stay deeply technical and hands-on with real production infrastructure.</li> <li>Guide outcomes from hardware delivery through running workloads.</li> <li>Shape how Cloudflare delivers compute capacity at scale.</li> <li>Build long-term, trust-based partnerships with world-class engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Capacity Onboarding & Delivery:</strong> Lead bringing new compute capacity online for the customer, collaborating on planning, provisioning, validation, and handover to production. Drive turn-ups that are predictable, efficient, and repeatable.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Hardware & Spec Validation:</strong> Partner with teams to ensure delivered systems meet agreed specifications. Define acceptance criteria and validation workflows, including burn-in, benchmarking, and health checks across compute, storage, and networking. Work alongside on-site data center teams to execute checks and resolve issues.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Standards & Operational Readiness:</strong> Champion Cloudflare's build, configuration, security, and observability standards prior to capacity launch. Ensure comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and runbooks are established for all production systems.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Cross-Team Alignment:</strong> Act as the central point of collaboration between Cloudflare's infrastructure, hardware engineering, data center operations, supply chain, and network teams, alongside the customer's engineering group.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Technical Accountability:</strong> Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer's infrastructure, guiding account strategy and technical direction for supporting Cloudflare resources.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Reliability & Incident Response:</strong> Engage in operational rhythms with the customer and Cloudflare, including standups, capacity reviews, change management, and incident response. Facilitate blameless root-cause analysis and post-incident improvements<br>.</li> <li><strong>Automation & Tooling:</strong> Develop production-quality automation and tooling for provisioning, validation, and fleet management to continually improve rollout efficiency.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Capacity Planning & Forecasting:</strong> Partner with the customer to understand future demand, forecast capacity needs, and proactively identify constraints.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Feedback Loop & Product Influence:</strong> Surface real-world operational issues and platform opportunities with Cloudflare's Infrastructure, Hardware, and Product teams to inform future roadmaps.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Strategic Relationship Management:</strong> Cultivate trusted technical relationships with senior stakeholders (Staff+ engineers, Directors, and VPs) across both organizations.<br><br></li> <li><strong>On-Site Presence:</strong> Spend time regularly on-site at customer offices to foster close communication and partnership with their engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <p><em>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Infrastructure & SRE Background:</strong> Solid experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, or production engineering, with a track record of running and scaling large-scale production systems.</li> <li><strong>Capacity & Fleet Operations:</strong> Practical experience bringing server capacity online, encompassing provisioning, imaging, configuration management, and fleet-scale lifecycle management.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Fluency:</strong> Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, BMC/IPMI/Redfish, and diagnostics. Ability to set validation standards, triage issues remotely, and partner with on-site technicians. Experience with GPUs or specialized accelerators is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Networking:</strong> Strong understanding of Linux systems and core networking principles (TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, load balancing, and data center topologies).</li> <li><strong>Automation & Development:</strong> Proficiency in languages such as Go, Python, or Rust, along with experience using infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Salt).</li> <li><strong>Production Ownership:</strong> Experience supporting mission-critical services, including on-call rotations, incident response, SLO management, and reliability engineering.</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong> Familiarity with monitoring, metrics, and logging frameworks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse) to maintain system health proactively.</li> <li><strong>Containers & Orchestration:</strong> Exposure to Kubernetes or similar platforms and workload scheduling on newly provisioned capacity.</li> <li><strong>AI-Augmented Workflows:</strong> Interest or experience in leveraging modern AI tools to streamline automation, debugging, and documentation.</li> <li><strong>Program-Level Coordination:</strong> Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex, multi-team delivery efforts across regions and time zones with clear communication and alignment.</li> <li><strong>Proactive Problem-Solving:</strong> A self-motivated approach to identifying bottlenecks—whether technical or procedural—and collaborating with partners to implement durable fixes.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Communication:</strong> Ability to engage comfortably in strategic technical discussions with executive-level stakeholders, translating infrastructure context into business outcomes.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Prior experience at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, or large-scale data center environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with Cloudflare's platform and network architecture.</li> <li>Experience in customer-embedded or partner-facing technical infrastructure roles.</li> <li>A history of sharing knowledge, such as technical writing, internal mentorship, open-source contributions, or community presentations.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000.</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> title: Manager I, Engineering - Language Platform
description: <p><a href="https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/">Application Performance Monitoring</a> (APM) is one of Datadog’s premier products that helps developers see inside complex distributed systems. Our SDKs are both the delivery vehicle for APM and the platform on which all of Datadog’s service and app based products (e.g. Application Security Management, Profiling, Data Stream Monitoring…) are delivered. We believe our SDKs are one of our technical moats and are a key competitive advantage for APM and Datadog more broadly. They’re also open-source.</p> <p>Leading the evolution of our SDKs is a technically demanding and highly collaborative effort. You’ll work with language experts to deliver cutting-edge observability products across our 9 supported languages, with industry leading performance and a world class developer experience. You’ll rethink our SDKs’ architecture, APIs, data models, and protocol to meet Datadog’s current needs and scale, all while building in the open. And you’ll grow your team’s capacity by fostering a culture focused on customer needs, continuous learning, and innovation. </p> <p>We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager who cares as much about technical excellence as empowering other engineering teams. </p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, grow, and develop a team of roughly 4-8 library engineers — coaching, giving direct feedback, and empowering senior ICs as technical leaders owning outcomes</li> <li>Own team delivery and productivity: planning, milestones, reviews</li> <li>Collaborate with Product teams to:</li> <ul> <li>Reshape and grow our platform capabilities to enable product teams </li> <li>Define and deliver industry leading, open-source, zero-touch APM instrumentation</li> </ul> <li>Stay technically close to the work — apply strong technical judgment, set a high standard for quality, contribute code where it matters most, and keep quality and architecture high</li> <li>Build strong relationships and drive alignment across the language teams and product, backend</li> <li>Shape team identity and culture</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>An experienced Engineering Manager with a track record of shipping </li> <li>A strong and empathetic leader with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams to deliver high quality software</li> <li>An ability pivot from high level product narratives to highly technical implementation details </li> <li>You have significant programming experience in one or more of: Go, C, Rust</li> <li><strong><em>Bonus</em></strong><strong>:</strong> If you possess experience with one or more of these skills: systems programming experience, observability tooling experience, experience shipping client side software, Go runtime expertise</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. </em></p> <p><strong>Benefits and Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li> <li>Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)</li> <li>Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions</li> <li>Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+</li> <li>Competitive global benefits</li> </ul> <p><br><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog: </strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on <a href="https://www.instagram.com/datadoghq/?hl=en" target="_blank">Instagram</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/datadog" target="_blank">LinkedIn,</a> and <a href="https://learn.datadoghq.com/" target="_blank">Datadog Learning Center. </a></p> <hr> <p data-renderer-start-pos="215"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Equal Opportunity at Datadog:</strong></p> <p>Datadog is proud to offer <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf" target="_blank">equal employment opportunity</a> to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/legal/candidate-legal-notices/" target="_blank">Candidate Legal Notices</a> for your reference. </p> <p>Datadog endeavors to make our Careers Page accessible to all users. title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée  en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit  de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.</p> <p><strong>Pré-requis</strong></p> <p>Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :<br>BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur<br>Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études<br>Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027<br>Durée : 4 à 6 mois</p> <p><strong>Références</strong></p> <ol> <li>Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. <em>Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision</em>, <em>64</em>(6), 672-689.</li> <li>Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In <em>Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency</em> (pp. 77-91). PMLR.</li> <li>Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.</li> <li>Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. <em>CoRR abs/2308.02935</em>.</li> <li>Thong, W., Joniak, P., & Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.</li> <li>Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., & Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In <em>ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings</em> (pp. 5344-5351).</li> <li>Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., & El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In <em>International conference on machine learning</em>(pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.</li> <li>Giuliani, L., Misino, E., & Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In <em>International Conference on Machine Learning</em> (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.</li> </ol> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
