title: Développeur Nouveaux Projets (F/H/X)
description: Localisation Poste basé à Lyon ou Dijon. Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique ! En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets , vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants. Vos missions · Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire. · Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires. · Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain. · Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques. · Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions. · Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets. · Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux. · Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement. · Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial. Votre profil · Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural. · Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial). · Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation. · Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux. · Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets. · Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation. Ce que NOVAR vous offre Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ? 💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours. 🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance. 🌴 Une prime vacances. 🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 🚗 Une voiture de fonction. 🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous. 📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS). 🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble. À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain. Intéressé(e) ? Prêt(e) pour la prochaine étape de votre carrière ? Postulez dès maintenant via le formulaire de candidature sur notre site internet et contribuez à créer un avenir plus durable ! Des questions? description: A propos du poste : Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Permis B requis. Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur . title: Account Operations & Farming Specialist
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Operations & Farming Specialist based in Switzerland. This role sits at the intersection of IT Operations, account infrastructure, and media buying support in a fast-growing international environment. You’ll take ownership of account access, lifecycle management, subscriptions, and operational processes while supporting Media Buying teams. A key part of the position is building and developing Meta account farming infrastructure and ensuring accounts are prepared for effective use. You’ll work with suppliers, proxies, browser profiles, email, phone numbers, 2FA, verification, and recovery processes. The role also involves identifying account-quality issues, analyzing losses and blocks, and improving processes through automation. It’s a strong opportunity for a systematic and proactive specialist who enjoys solving operational challenges and building scalable infrastructure. Accountabilities: Manage employee access, including account provisioning, access maintenance, onboarding, and offboarding processes. Manage user accounts, services, internal tools, subscriptions, licenses, and related operational resources. Provide IT Operations support to Media Buying teams, ensuring they have the accounts, tools, and infrastructure required to work effectively. Maintain accurate records, documentation, account inventories, and current operational statuses. Build, manage, and continuously improve Meta account farming and account infrastructure processes. Prepare advertising accounts and related resources for Media Buying teams. Manage suppliers and account resources, including proxies, email addresses, phone numbers, 2FA, browser profiles, and recovery data. Handle account checkpoints, verification, recovery, and related troubleshooting processes. Monitor account quality and analyze the causes of account losses, restrictions, or blocks. Collaborate with Farm teams to share knowledge, adopt relevant expertise, and improve operational practices. Identify repetitive or inefficient processes and define requirements for automation. Contribute to a structured, scalable, and well-documented account operations environment. Requirements: Hands-on experience with Meta farming and/or advertising account infrastructure. Solid understanding of the advertising account lifecycle, from setup and preparation through ongoing management and recovery. Practical experience handling checkpoints, verification, and account recovery. Experience working with proxies, anti-detect or browser-profile solutions, email accounts, phone numbers, and 2FA. Experience managing suppliers or other account-related resources. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate issues and propose practical solutions. Highly systematic and detail-oriented when working with access permissions, accounts, operational resources, and data. Comfortable combining account-farming responsibilities with broader IT Operations tasks. Strong documentation skills and the ability to create and maintain clear processes. A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of problems rather than waiting for instructions. Nice to have: Experience building a farming or account infrastructure process from scratch. Experience with TikTok or Google account infrastructure. Familiarity with Airtable, n8n, Make, or comparable workflow and automation tools. Knowledge of APIs, webhooks, or other automation technologies. Experience with Meta Developer tools, Business Verification, or App Review. Previous experience in affiliate marketing, media buying, or a similar performance-driven environment. Benefits: Fully remote work, with the flexibility to work from a location where you feel comfortable and productive. Access to company hubs in Kyiv and Warsaw if an office environment is preferred. 20 paid working days of annual leave, public holidays, and paid sick leave. Medical insurance with access to leading healthcare providers. Psychological support coverage through the Pleso platform. Monthly Benefit Café allowance that can be used for hobbies, sports, and personal interests. Team-building activities, corporate events, workshops, and other social initiatives. Individual learning budget for courses and professional development. Corporate English classes, workshops, and access to an online learning library. Career development opportunities supported by performance reviews, training, and mentoring programs. An open and collaborative culture that values initiative, direct communication, and constructive feedback. Opportunities to work with in-house technology capabilities and contribute to solutions built from the ground up. Strong focus on automation and reducing routine work to create more time for professional development. Flexible, low-bureaucracy environment that encourages autonomy and freedom of action. International exposure and the opportunity to collaborate with specialized teams in a growing organization. title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)
description: <p> </p> <h1>Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) </h1> <p>Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées</p> <h2>À propos de l’opportunité</h2> <p>Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.</p> <p>En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.</p> <p>Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.</p> </li> <li> <p>Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.</p> </li> <li> <p>Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.</p> </li> <li> <p>Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous recherchons</h2> <h3>Indispensable</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.</p> </li> <li> <p>Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d’expérience et à persévérer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une bonne compréhension du statut d’indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Atouts</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Un réseau existant de chefs d’entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.</p> <h2>Rémunération</h2> <p>Il s’agit d’une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l’activité des commerçants apportés.</p> <p>Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :</p> <ul> <li> <p>Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.</p> </li> <li> <p>Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.</p> </li> <li> <p>Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.</p> </li> <li> <p>Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.</p> </li> <li> <p>Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d’activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s’appliquer.</p> <p>Les conditions d’éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s’entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.</p> <h2>Formation et accompagnement</h2> <p>Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l’accompagnement des clients.</p> <p>Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.</p> <p>Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d’analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d’organisation.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. title: STAGE R&D - Modélisation quantitative du risque sur les marchés prédictifs
description: Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique. Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ? Techniquement, Winamax c’est : Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience Contexte L'offre de paris sportifs chez Winamax repose sur le traitement en temps réel de flux massifs de données et l'ajustement continu de probabilités. Pour garantir la cohérence entre les cotes et l'exposition financière de Winamax, l'analyse automatisée des mouvements de marché, du volume des mises et des activités atypiques est devenue un enjeu stratégique. La question à laquelle doit répondre le stage : Comment détecter algorithmiquement les incohérences de probabilités et les volumes atypiques en temps réel pour fournir un Indice de Confiance fiable, capable d'assister la prise de décision ? Objectifs du stage Modéliser la cohérence des cotes et un Indice de Confiance : Concevoir des modèles statistiques pour repérer les décalages de probabilités et évaluer en temps réel la fiabilité des activités à fort volume, en croisant la notoriété de l'événement et son historique Intégrer le module au cœur de l'outil trading existant : Développer une brique algorithmique performante qui s'interface directement avec l'application métier des traders, afin d'enrichir leurs outils Validation & mesure de performance (Backtesting) : Tester et calibrer les modèles sur des historiques massifs de données pour maximiser leur précision, minimiser les fausses alertes et mesurer l'impact réel de l'outil sur l'activité Les points d'attention Temps réel et faible latence : capacité à traiter des flux à haute fréquence (milliers d'actualisations et d'activités par seconde) sans ralentir la réactivité des outils Volume de données et backtesting : manipulation de séries temporelles complexes et capacité à tester/ajuster les modèles sur des bases historiques de plusieurs millions de lignes Précision du ciblage (taux de faux positifs) : nécessité d'ajuster finement les seuils statistiques pour remonter des signaux réellement pertinents sans engorger l'outil d'alertes inutiles Stack technique Python, Node.js, Sql Modalités de stage Stage de fin d'études (Master 2) à pourvoir à temps plein uniquement à Paris, France Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage Rémunération : 30k Processus de recrutement Test technique Screening RH avec Camille Entretien avec le manager et le maître de stage POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages ! Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique Une semaine de travail en 4 jours Opportunité de CDI si tu as atteint les objectifs du stage Coaching de tes soft skills avec les Cours Florent Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…) Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…) Des primes d’intéressement et de participation si tu restes parmi nous à l'issue de ton stage Un accès au programme de cooptation (bonus de cooptation jusqu’à 5000 €) Un restaurant d’entreprise Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: About AQEMIA AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI , our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles. What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules , without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies. Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization , targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives. For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page , and our LinkedIn . About our Team AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery. This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention. About our Engineering Department The Engineering team (~12 people) builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine. Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale. Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience. The role As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll own AQEMIA's data platform end to end — from ingestion through the pipeline to the trusted, model-ready datasets that power science, ML and analytics. What makes this role distinctive is the data itself: chemical structures, molecular conformations, physics- and ML-based predictions, and experimental results from CROs and partners. A core part of the work is modelling these scientific entities well — establishing canonical identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous, often messy sources — so scientists, and increasingly AI agents, can rely on them. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, data infrastructure and scientific research, with real scope to shape architecture rather than just execute against it. As AQEMIA moves toward more service and API-driven integration next year, you'll help make data fit for automation — expanding your impact from pipelines to the systems that consume them. Responsibilities Own AQEMIA's Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation and delivery, maintaining lineage and traceability as data volume and complexity grow. Model canonical scientific entities — compounds, structures, assays, predictions — establishing identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous and often messy sources. Set and uphold data quality standards through monitoring, validation, testing and alerting across critical pipelines, strengthening governance and observability so datasets stay trusted and accessible. Partner with ML engineers, data scientists and researchers to build curated, model-ready datasets, translating scientific and business requirements into scalable data solutions. Drive data architecture and engineering best practices — data modeling, testing, documentation, orchestration and deployment — in collaboration with the Engineering Manager and Staff Data Engineer on roadmap execution. Build self-service capabilities and, looking ahead, APIs that make data fit for automation as AQEMIA moves toward more service-based integration. Uphold engineering quality through code reviews, and mentor junior engineers by sharing knowledge and best practices as a senior individual contributor. Qualifications Deep experience in data engineering, with a track record of production systems that other teams depend on. We care about what you have built, not the year count. Strong software engineering skills. You code, you review code, and you hold a quality bar. Expert in Python and SQL. - Strong data modelling and relational database experience. You can defend an identity key. Production experience with a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a transformation framework (we use dbt). title: GenAI Engineer (F/H/NB)
description: SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway . Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network ), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts ( Individual Contributor / IC ), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ▪️ À propos de la mission En tant qu'Expert & Trainer GenAI, tu t'inscris à la croisée de l'ingénierie logicielle, de la formation d'élite et du conseil stratégique. Tu es le garant de la mise en œuvre pragmatique et sécurisée de l'IA chez nos clients. Architecture & Ingénierie GenAI Tu concois, pilotes et déploies des architectures GenAI robustes et prêtes pour la production : Model Engineering & Contexte : Arbitrage et choix des LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Open Source), optimisation des paramètres (fenêtre de contexte, context caching , system prompts ) et maîtrise du Model Context Protocol (MCP). Pipelines Avancés & RAG : Conception de stratégies de retrieval complexes (chunking, bases vectorielles, GraphRAG, hybride) et orchestration de workflows agentiques (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, patterns ReAct). Industrialisation & FinOps : Évaluation de la fiabilité (LLM-as-a-judge), maîtrise des coûts au token, guardrails de sécurité (AI Act, prompt injection, étanchéité des données) et déploiement multi-cloud (Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI). Formation & Transmission "Développeur Augmenté" (SFEIR Institute) Tu es le visage de l'excellence pédagogique de SFEIR. Tu conçois et animes nos parcours phares (jusqu'à 60% de pratique / labs) pour transformer les méthodes de dev chez nos clients : Agentic Coding : Acculturation aux workflows de développement assisté ( Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement → Validate ) via des outils comme Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou Gemini CLI. Standardisation d'équipe : Diffusion des bonnes pratiques de gestion de contexte ( CLAUDE.md , règles modulaires, génération de tests) et création de serveurs MCP sécurisés. Pédagogie & Regard Critique : Vulgarisation adaptative (du décideur à l'ingénieur) tout en insufflant une culture de la sécurité (code review, vulnérabilités) et du maintien des compétences en dev classique. Conseil & Stratégie GenAI Tu transformes des besoins métiers complexes ou flous en feuilles de route opérationnelles et à fort ROI : Cadrage & Roadmap : Animation d'ateliers d'idéation, priorisation des cas d'usage ( Quick Wins vs Chantiers structurants ) et construction du business case pour les sponsors. Architecture de Solutions : Arbitrages Build vs Buy , conception de couches intermédiaires (Context Graphs) pour maîtriser la dette technique et l'économie du token. Gouvernance & Change : Accompagnement des instances dirigeantes (COMEX, CODIR) sur la gestion du risque, la conformité et la conduite du changement. ▪️ Le profil idéal Formation & Parcours : Titulaire d'un Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur ou Master universitaire) ou bénéficiant d'une solide expérience terrain équivalente dans la conception logicielle et l'architecture système. Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience globale en ingénierie logicielle ou architecture cloud, avec une spécialisation marquée et récente en IA générative , ingénierie de prompt et orchestration agentique. Une première expérience réussie en formation/consulting ou une appétence forte pour la transmission est indispensable. ▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence. ▪️ Tes conditions de travail Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. ▪️ Le processus de recrutement Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, Python, GenAI) avec trois Sfeirians. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence. Tes missions au quotidien : Back-end : Maîtrise avancée de C# / .NET 8+, architectures Microservices et APIs sécurisées Data & Messaging : Gestion de la donnée sous toutes ses formes avec SQL Server, MongoDB et architectures orientées événements via Kafka Cloud & Industrialisation : Déploiement sur environnements Cloud Public (Azure, AWS ou GCP) et conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes) Craftsmanship : Le Clean Code, le TDD et les revues de code sont tes standards de livraison, pas des options ▪️ Le profil idéal Formation & Parcours : Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur, Master) ou équivalent. Databases & Messaging : SQL Server, MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ. DevOps & Cloud : DevOps (CI/CD), Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana. Outillage : Git, JIRA. title: Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
description: Intro Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 580 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet. Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern. In dieser Rolle wirst Du Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen. Betriebsergebnisse und Geschäftsziele verantworten: Die betrieblichen Leistungskennzahlen zu Patientenzufriedenheit, Finanzindikatoren, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Rentabilität wirst Du überwachen. Ferner wirst Du mit den Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Budgets, Finanzprognosen und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten. Leistungsziele definieren: Du wirst Leistungsbewertungen durchführen und Ziele definieren. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein positives Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert. Die regionale Strategie planen: Die Formulierung regionaler, strategischer Pläne im Einklang mit unseren übergeordneten Geschäftszielen erarbeitest Du. Hierfür wirst Du eng mit dem Head of Operations sowie Ärzten und Fachkräften vor Ort arbeiten und netzwerken. Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen. Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman). Leitenden Angestellten und Führungskräften bei Sanoptis, darunter der Head of Operations und das Führungsteam, das für klinische Innovation und hervorragende Dienstleistungen verantwortlich ist. Renommierten Spezialisten und führenden Experten auf dem Gebiet der Augenheilkunde. Einem engagierten und qualifizierten Team von medizinischen Fachkräften und Assistenzärzten. Interdisziplinären Teams in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, einschließlich Technologieexperten, die an den neuesten Fortschritten in der augenmedizinischen Behandlung und digitalen Gesundheitslösungen arbeiten. Dein Profil überzeugt durch Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, Bain, BCG o.Ä.) oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen. Die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen auf Führungsebene zu erstellen und zu kommunizieren. Du erstellst Analysen akribisch und detailorientiert. Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit wenig Anleitung ist essenziell. Nachgewiesene Erfolge im Umgang mit Interessensgruppen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und Dir eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu sichern. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen Konflikte konstruktiv zu lösen und Durchsetzungsstärke zu behalten. Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Bereich Organisation und Prozessmanagement. Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Englischkenntnisse. Die Bereitschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und Dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Verantwortung zu entfalten. Sanoptis bietet Dir Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst attraktives Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen, leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Leistungsziele gebunden ist. Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, Dich zu beweisen, indem Du selbstständig arbeitest und eigene, innovative Ideen umfassend einbringst als Führungspersönlichkeit. Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle. Kontakt Wenn Du bereit bist, die digitale Zukunft der Augenheilkunde mitzugestalten, möchten wir von Dir hören! title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. You will lead a team of analysts responsible for developing the credit and pricing strategies as we bring our products to market across the EU.</p> <p>Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Head of Hardware
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage. What You Will Do Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why. Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree. Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room. Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets. Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy. Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured. Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result. Requirements You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale. Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today. You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer. You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took. A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly. Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before. Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Nice to Have Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé. Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization. Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures. Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time. Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong. Open-source hardware or firmware contributions. Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. title: Customer Engineering Specialist - Network Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations:  Lisbon</strong></p> <h4>Customer Engineering Specialist - Network Services</h4> <h4>About Us</h4> <h4>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </h4> <h4>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</h4> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>As a CE Specialist you will be the trusted technical advisor for customers adopting Cloudflare's network services. These include Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall and Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI), alongside Cloudflare One. You will lead Magic Transit and Cloudflare WAN POCs from design through to production cutover. You will also help customers modernize how they protect, connect and secure their networks and sites.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers choose the right Cloudflare network and security solution for their business needs.</li> <li>Lead qualified prospects through Solution Design and POC.</li> <ul> <li><strong>Magic Transit:</strong> plan and run POCs covering BGP onboarding, prefix advertisement, GRE/IPsec tunnels or CNI, and DDoS validation.</li> <li><strong>Cloudflare WAN:</strong> plan and run POCs covering site and branch connectivity (IPsec/GRE tunnels, CNI, Cloudflare One Appliance), data center and cloud-to-site connectivity, routing design, and coexistence with or migration from existing SD-WAN or MPLS.</li> </ul> <li>Understand the customer's network topology, IP addressing, routing policy and security requirements. Then design an architecture that fits, including hybrid environments with Azure, AWS and GCP.</li> <li>Run technical discovery, demos and workshops as part of the pre-sales cycle. Support RFP/RFI responses and technical validation.</li> <li>Explain the benefits of Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN and Cloudflare One compared with alternative approaches. These include traditional DDoS scrubbing services, appliance-based protection, SD-WAN solutions, next-generation firewalls and MPLS or traditional WAN.</li> <li>Work with GTM partners to consistently achieve pipeline and revenue goals.</li> <li>Present network and security transformation messages to senior technical leaders and executives.</li> <li>Capture product and feature gaps and feed them back to Product and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Core requirements</h2> <ul> <li><strong>GTM experience:</strong> 5+ years in Customer Engineering, Pre-sales, Solutions or Systems Engineering, or Technical Sales. You should have experience guiding customers through discovery, solution design, POC and handover to delivery or support.</li> <li><strong>BGP and routing:</strong> Strong working knowledge of BGP (eBGP, route advertisement and filtering, AS paths, communities, anycast, RPKI and route hygiene). You should also be comfortable with static and dynamic routing, subnetting, route-based policy and split tunnels.</li> <li><strong>TCP/IP:</strong> Deep understanding of the TCP/IP protocol stack and packet-level troubleshooting (for example with tcpdump and Wireshark). This includes MTU/MSS, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT and asymmetric routing.</li> <li><strong>DDoS protection:</strong> Understanding of L3/L4/L7 DDoS attack types and mitigation approaches (for example volumetric floods, SYN floods, amplification and reflection attacks). You should also understand how on-demand and always-on protection differ.</li> <li><strong>SD-WAN and WAN architecture:</strong> Familiarity with SD-WAN architectures and routing protocols (BGP and OSPF overlays), underlay and overlay design, local internet breakout, branch connectivity, and migration from MPLS or legacy WAN.</li> <li>Fluent in English, written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.</li> <li>Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines and prioritize between competing goals.</li> <li>Curiosity and learning agility. Cloudflare sits at the cutting edge of internet technology, so you are expected to keep up with industry trends as well as our own products.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable skills</h2> <p><strong>Network and security fundamentals</strong></p> <ul> <li>DNS: Good knowledge of DNS, including authoritative and recursive resolution, DNSSEC, DNS over HTTPS/TLS, DNS-based attacks (such as tunneling and cache poisoning) and DNS filtering.</li> <li>Detailed understanding of the path from user to application, including hybrid and multi-cloud architectures (Azure, AWS, GCP).</li> <li>Knowledge of end-user and application security risks. These include DDoS, malware, phishing, viruses, ransomware.</li> <li>VPN and remote access challenges, and moving to Zero Trust access.</li> <li>SIEM and log analytics platforms. You should also be comfortable with network telemetry such as NetFlow and sFlow.</li> <li>Experience and knowledge with network and security vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point (covering architecture, capabilities, configuration, and troubleshooting).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Market and competitive knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of the market for CDN providers, Web Application Firewalls, remote access solutions, next-generation firewalls, CASB, DDoS mitigation, SD-WAN and secure gateway solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cloudflare One and Zero Trust</strong></p> <ul> <li>SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.</li> <li>Knowledge of Cloudflare Zero Trust solutions: Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation, and WARP client deployment.</li> <li>Secure Web Gateway, CASB and DLP.</li> <li>IdP and authentication (SAML, OTP), plus SaaS application integration and tenant controls.</li> <li>Client OS fundamentals and software distribution.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €74,000 - €106,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-foc

title: Head of Credit Risk Oversight
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €121,000 - €163,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Risk team</strong></p> <p>Monzo is building a bank for Europe, and lending sits at the heart of that plan. The Head of Credit Risk Oversight is a senior risk leadership role in the Second Line of Defence (2nd LoD), shaping how Monzo Bank Europe lends as it scales across the continent. You'll join early enough to set the standard, and stay to see it grow with the portfolio. Roles like this don't come along often.</p> <p>You'll lead the oversight of Monzo Bank Europe’s whole lending business. That means driving our Credit Risk Framework, defining the risk appetite, challenging and shaping our credit strategy, and overseeing how the business executes it within that appetite, right across the credit lifecycle. You'll spot the risks inthe portfolio before they show up in the numbers, so Monzo Bank Europe can grow fast and keep growing.</p> <p>You'll also lead our credit risk analytics and measurement. You'll direct the development of our IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, make sure our impairment provisions hold up, and turn portfolio data into insight the business acts on. You'll do that with modern methods and technology, including artificial intelligence, and set the standard for how we use and control them.</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Credit Risk, Monzo Bank Europe.</p> <p><em>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function (CF-2) within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards 2018 issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</em></p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Credit Risk Framework and Appetite</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Developing, implementing and continuously improving our Credit Risk Framework in Europe, keeping it aligned to the entity's strategy.</li> <li>Formulating and overseeing the Credit Risk Appetite Statement and its limit structure, so lending growth stays inside agreed boundaries.</li> <li>Turning appetite into practical limits, triggers and escalation paths, and overseeing how the First Line of Defence (1st LoD) puts them into practice.</li> <li>Embedding group-wide credit risk frameworks locally, with clear escalation between global standards and local policy.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> 2nd LoD oversight of credit risk activities</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Giving independent oversight and challenge across credit policy, underwriting and credit decisioning strategies, affordability, pricing, and collections and recovery.</li> <li>Issuing formal 2nd LoD opinions on new products, policy and strategy changes, and material lending decisions.</li> <li>Reviewing portfolio asset quality regularly, including performance trends, vintage analysis and emerging pockets of risk.</li> <li>Overseeing the adequacy assessment of IFRS 9 impairment provisions, and giving a clear 2nd LoD view on whether provisions are appropriate.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Credit risk measurement</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Leading the measurement of our credit risk end to end, from data and methodology through to the loss estimates we report.</li> <li>Owning the development and maintenance of the IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, including the PD, LGD, EAD and forward-looking information (FLI) inputs behind them.</li> <li>Setting the methodology for staging, significant increase in credit risk, macroeconomic scenarios and post-model adjustments.</li> <li>Keeping model documentation and evidence in good shape, and closing validation findings on time.</li> <li>Bringing advanced techniques and artificial intelligence into how we build and run these models, with the controls and transparency that come with them.</li> <li>Supplying credit risk parameters and expert input to capital, stress testing and financial planning work.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Monitoring, early warning and MI</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Building credit risk monitoring and early warning processes that spot problems early.</li> <li>Delivering high quality, timely credit risk management information and insight to senior internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Making the numbers tell a clear story, so people can make decisions quickly and confidently.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Committee governance and independent challenge</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Acting as Secretariat and Deputy Chair of the Credit Risk Oversight Committee, shaping agendas, tracking actions, and presenting 2nd LoD reports and opinions.</li> <li>Escalating credit risk appetite breaches and material risks promptly to the Executive Risk Committee and the Board Risk Committee.</li> <li>Giving clear, evidence-based challenge to 1st LoD credit, analytics and product teams, and to accountable executives.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Regulatory compliance and engagement</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Making sure credit risk management meets the legal and regulatory requirements of the markets we operate in, including Central Bank of Ireland (CBI) requirements, Irish and European Union law, and European Banking Authority (EBA) and European Central Bank (ECB) guidelines.</li> <li>Leading the 2nd LoD assessment of changing and new credit regulation.</li> <li>Supporting regulatory reporting and engagement, and supporting the Director of Credit Risk on executing their PCF-22 obligations.</li> <li>Acting as a key point of contact for the CBI, internal audit and external auditors on credit risk matters.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Leadership and stakeholder management</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Building the credit risk oversight function from the ground up. You'll start hands-on, then hire and lead a team as the business grows.</li> <li>Putting cutting-edge technology at the heart of how the function works from day one, including generative and agentic artificial intelligence, and making sure we control those tools as carefully as we control everything else.</li> <li>Balancing commercial ambition with rigorous risk boundaries, and helping the business grow safely.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a degree in a quantitative or financial discipline, such as Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or Financial Engineering. Further qualifications like the CFA, FRM or PRM are a strong plus.</li> <li>You've led credit risk oversight or credit risk measurement in a retail bank, challenger bank or a top financial regulatory consulting practice, ideally in a regulated European Union entity.</li> <li>You know retail credit risk modelling inside out: PD, LGD, EAD, IFRS 9 staging and expected credit loss, affordability and forward-looking information.</li> <li>You've owned or independently challenged credit risk appetite, credit policy, underwriting and collections strategies, and you can tell a strong one from a weak one.</li> <li>You understand European regulation well, including EBA and ECB guidelines, IFRS 9, the CCD2 and GDPR, and how they apply day to day.</li> <li>You have proven experience in independent engagement with with internal and external auditors and supervisory authorities, preferably the CBI and/or ECB</li> <li>You're tech-fluent, with hands-on SQL and Python, and keen to use generative and agentic artificial intelligence to speed up risk work, with clear eyes on the controls that need to come with it.</li> <li>You give clear, structured, objective challenge to 1st LoD teams, and people listen because your evidence is strong.</li> <li>You've built credit risk frameworks, models or governance from scratch, including where data is sparse.</li> <li>You can turn complex analysis into simple, useful insight for senior management and the board.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 A salary range of €121,000 - €163,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and cou

title: Go (Golang) Software Engineer, Developer Tooling and Containers

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. You will also build the frameworks and playbooks that allow this work to scale across the broader Executive Engagements Programs. We're looking for a resourceful, entrepreneurial individual who thrives in ambiguous situations, can think critically under pressure, and can manage relationships and build consensus with stakeholders at all levels. title: Commercial Account Executive, UAE & Oman
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with.
