If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>San Francisco, CA | Austin, TX | New York City, NY</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for a Social Media Strategy Director to redefine how Cloudflare shows up online. In this role, you will think like a storyteller—transforming our deep data pools, research, and corporate milestones into a sophisticated, multi-platform strategy. You will oversee global social media, executive digital positioning, web-based storytelling, and community-driven engagement to build a cohesive, influential, and authentic digital brand.</p> <p>You are a visionary storyteller, a sharp strategist, and an Internet-native thinker. You understand that how we communicate on GitHub, Reddit, Hacker News, and YouTube matters just as much as a headline in The Wall Street Journal. This role isn't just about managing a content calendar; it’s about strategically deploying Cloudflare's voice on LinkedIn, X, and via digital assets to influence enterprise buyers, developers, tech policy leaders, and the global business community.</p> <p>If you understand Internet subcultures, appreciate a great tech meme, and know how to foster genuine developer loyalty at scale, this is your sandbox.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Architect the Digital Strategy:</strong> Define the overarching vision for Cloudflare’s corporate digital channels, ensuring our voice is distinct, authoritative, and deeply understood by tech-savvy audiences and enterprise buyers alike.</li> <li><strong>Elevate Executive Positioning:</strong> Partner directly with our executive leadership team to shape and scale their personal digital brands, turning complex industry trends into compelling online narratives.</li> <li><strong>Drive Multi-Channel Storytelling: </strong>Manage our corporate social media channels (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc.) while expanding our strategic footprint into emerging platforms and technical communities.</li> <li><strong>Bridge Tech and Culture:</strong> Translate highly complex technical milestones—from network infrastructure to post-quantum cryptography—into creative, engaging, and accessible digital content.</li> <li><strong>Crisis & Rapid Response: </strong>Act as a critical node in our crisis management engine. When internet-scale events happen, you will ensure our digital response is swift, transparent, accurate, and aligned with our core values.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Optimization</strong>: Establish robust measurement frameworks to track brand sentiment, share of voice, and engagement, continuously iterating our strategy based on hard data.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Experience: </strong>10+ years of experience in corporate communications, digital strategy, or brand journalism, with at least 4+ years leading high-performing digital or social teams in the B2B tech or SaaS space.</li> <li><strong>Deep Tech Literacy: </strong>You don't need to write code, but you must be able to hold your own with engineers and product managers. You understand how the Internet works and can explain the "why" behind cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity.</li> <li><strong>Platform Fluent: </strong>You know the algorithms, subcultures, and unwritten rules of LinkedIn, X, Reddit, YouTube, and Threads. title: Accounts Receivable Clerk
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Receivable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world-class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick-start your career in Finance!</p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team.</p> <p>Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/R ledgers, processing customer invoices in a timely and accurate manner, registering customer payments, dealing with queries effectively and efficiently and maintaining compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return, we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development, including offering you support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <p>Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/R ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our customer data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of customer data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our customer invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Efficiently resolve any problems prior to raising and issue of invoice</li> <li>Implement and comply with the Canonical credit control policy</li> <li>Maximise cash collection through the effective collection of debts and maintain records to track debt collection through to conclusion</li> <li>Ensure payments are received in line with contractual terms</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, lookups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organization skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an enterprise level accounting system </li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><em>Canonical believes a diverse workforce enhances our ability to deliver world class software and services which meet the world’s computing needs. title: Engineering Manager - Distributed Systems, Python / Go
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across many sectors.</p> <p>Canonical is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an<strong> Engineering Manager for Distributed Systems Testing </strong>to lead a team responsible for the quality engineering platform that enables deployment and validation of distributed systems across Canonical's cloud portfolio.</p> <p>We see quality engineering as a first-class engineering practice. Our Distributed Systems Testing team ensures the performance, correctness, resilience and interoperability of Canonical cloud solutions built with technologies such as Juju, Terraform, OpenStack and Kubernetes. These systems are deployed and tested across diverse environments, from bare-metal to the public cloud.</p> <p>As Engineering Manager, you will combine strong software engineering judgement with people leadership. You will develop engineering talent, establish effective engineering practices, shape technical direction with senior engineers, and ensure the team delivers high-quality testing infrastructure and automation that enables engineering teams across Canonical to ship software with confidence.</p> <p>We believe engineering managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. You should be comfortable reviewing patches, evaluating software design, debugging a distributed system, or discussing test architecture. You will contribute technically where appropriate to set a high standard, while recognizing that your greatest impact comes from shaping the direction, focus, effectiveness, and growth of the whole team.</p> <p>You will work closely with senior engineers and engineering leaders across Canonical to define priorities, improve testing capabilities, and advance how we validate increasingly complex cloud-native and distributed systems.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a globally remote role, typically leading a team concentrated within a major time zone such as EMEA or the Americas.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of software and quality engineers, ranging from graduate to senior level</li> <li>Set clear expectations, strengthen engineering practices, and ensure timely delivery against agreed goals</li> <li>Partner with senior engineers to shape technical strategy, architecture, roadmap, and engineering standards</li> <li>Guide the development of automated testing infrastructure for the reliability, interoperability, and resilience of distributed systems</li> <li>Improve CI pipelines, testing tools, and reporting used to validate Canonical's products and solutions across bare-metal, private and public cloud environments</li> <li>Enable engineering teams across Canonical to adopt effective distributed-systems testing practices and tooling</li> <li>Contribute technical leadership through design and code reviews, debugging, and hands-on engineering where appropriate</li> <li>Represent the team with stakeholders and collaborate across Canonical on quality engineering, infrastructure, and developer experience</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we're looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Experience in leading, coaching, and mentoring software engineers</li> <li>Professional software engineering experience with Python or Go</li> <li>Expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, quality engineering, or a closely related domain</li> <li>Strong knowledge of modern software testing processes, strategies, and automation</li> <li>Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) </li> <li>Strong technical judgement and the ability to engage meaningfully in code reviews, architecture discussions, and software design</li> <li>Experience working in an agile development environment with the ability to organize a team to deliver high-quality results</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent communication and presentation skills </li> <li>Great interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability, demonstrating passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Additional skills we value</strong></h2> <p>Experience with any of the following:</p> <ul> <li>Cloud technologies such as Kubernetes, OpenStack, Juju, Terraform, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure</li> <li>Designing testing strategies for distributed or cloud-native systems</li> <li>Building or operating large-scale CI/CD and test infrastructure</li> <li>Applying AI or machine learning to test analysis, failure classification, or engineering workflows</li> <li>Deploying, operating, or debugging distributed systems</li> <li>Leading globally distributed teams</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually, and more often for graduates and associates, to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus.</p> <p>We provide all team members with additional benefits that reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programmes to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme and wellness support</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and a leading platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software.</p> <p>We recruit globally and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: Global Head of Land Revenue
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As Global Head of Land Revenue, you’ll be the global owner for technical new-business strategy, pipeline, and conversion—a customer-facing, technical revenue leadership role, not a RevOps or sales operations role. You’ll own Notion’s Land number (net-new and upgrade iARR across regions), work closely with EPD and Product, and step into high-stakes technical conversations with customers and partners as Notion shifts from product-led to sales-led selling in an AI-native world. This role is the global owner for new business standards, pipeline programs, and operating cadence. You’ll set the way for landing new business revenue globally, partner with Regional GMs who own regional P&L outcomes, and ensure consistent execution through scalable programs, playbooks, enablement, and governance. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, Sales leadership, and regional teams to improve pipeline quality, win rates, conversion, and time-to-productivity. You’ll also design operating standards that balance regional accountability with global program consistency. You’ll be measured on qualified pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, program ROI, velocity, handoff quality, and BDR/SC ramp outcomes—requiring you to operate with strong systems thinking, executive presence, and cross-functional influence. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Build and lead the global net-new business motion: define strategy, program portfolio, operating cadence, governance, and performance standards across regions - Own the global net new business strategy for Land, including ICP and segmentation guardrails, plays, coverage model assumptions, annual and quarterly planning, sequencing, and investment trade-offs - Establish global definitions and standards for stages, qualification, handoffs, pipeline math assumptions, and reporting integrity - Build and run global pipeline generation programs in partnership with Marketing and regional leaders, including campaign-to-pipeline motions, partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account plays, and field event program standards - Define the measurement framework for new business programs, connecting inputs to outputs and outcomes across cost, pipeline, iARR, velocity, and win-rate lift - Own the Land-side technical selling motion and set the technical bar for sales: SC plays, discovery and demo standards, scalable demo environments, certification paths, and ramp mechanisms - Run the global new business operating cadence, including weekly program reviews, monthly pipeline health inspection, quarterly planning, escalation paths, and decision-rights models - Partner with Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Product, and Partnerships to align new business programs, systems, content, enablement, feedback loops, and change management SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Deeply technical SaaS background with meaningful customer-facing experience—solutions engineering, solutions consulting, field or customer engineering, or technical sales—plus ownership of a revenue, quota, pipeline, or conversion outcome - Deep understanding of pipeline mechanics and how to influence conversion levers end-to-end, including qualified pipeline creation, coverage ratios, lead response, handoff quality, stage progression, win-rate lift, and velocity - Strong program-building instincts: you can design scalable plays, instrument them with data, and run an inspection cadence that drives behavior change - Experience building operating systems for global teams, including cadences, dashboards, governance, playbooks, definitions, and change-management mechanisms - Executive presence and cross-functional leadership: able to align and influence Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting lines for every dependency - Ability to balance regional autonomy with global craft excellence: you set the bar, create standards, and drive consistency while enabling local execution - Strong enablement and role-design instincts, with the ability to define expectations, onboarding paths, certification standards, and time-to-productivity mechanisms for BDR and SC motions - Builder orientation and comfort in ambiguity: you create the playbook while the org is executing, and you iterate quickly based on market, customer, and performance signals - Hands-on with AI tools, and able to credibly explain how AI and agents change workflows for technical teams NICE TO HAVES: - Experience with solution-led selling motions and technical or product-adjacent go-to-market - Track record building global programs that still allow regional adaptation - Experience partnering deeply with Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and Enablement to create measurable net new business impact - Experience designing partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account motions, or field event program standards at scale We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. title: Senior Internal Controls Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Internal Controls Manager to join the Finance team at Monzo Bank Europe DAC based in Dublin.</p> <p>You will help Finance build and maintain a strong risk and control environment as we develop and grow our business across European markets. You will test key Finance controls, review evidence, support regulatory reporting assurance, track remediation actions and help improve the way Finance manages risk.</p> <p>Working across Financial Control, Regulatory Reporting, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Risk & Compliance and Internal Audit, you will bring your accounting expertise, strong attention to detail and a practical approach to controls. You will be comfortable challenging processes, writing clear findings and helping teams improve.</p> <p>This is a great role for someone from audit, financial control or risk assurance who wants to help build a high-quality and robust Finance control environment in a growing digital bank.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintaining a robust and well-documented risk and control environment by improving documentation, evidence standards and control processes for the Finance team, and helping to ensure Finance-owned risks are aligned with MBEU’s risk appetite and the wider Enterprise Risk Management Framework.</li> <li>Designing, maintaining and enhancing Finance risk and control matrices for key processes.</li> <li>Performing regular control testing and review of evidence across Finance processes, including financial reporting, month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, regulatory reporting, tax, treasury and capital/liquidity-related processes.</li> <li>Testing Finance controls and assessing design and operating effectiveness. Identifying control gaps, recommending enhancements, and embedding change by tracking remediation actions and progress.</li> <li>Leading and supporting Finance risk and control self-assessments, including evidence gathering, challenge and documentation.</li> <li>Preparing concise updates for Finance leadership on control testing results, open issues, remediation progress and emerging risks. Supporting risk assurance reporting to MBEU governance forums.</li> <li>Working with second-line Risk & Compliance teams on oversight reviews, assurance planning and risk reporting.</li> <li>Supporting Internal Audit and external audit requests relating to Finance controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold a recognised accounting qualification, or be close to qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA Ireland or equivalent.</li> <li>Have detailed experience in audit, financial control, risk assurance, internal controls or regulatory reporting.</li> <li>Have experience in Banking, fintech or financial services experience.</li> <li>Can demonstrate a strong understanding of accounting processes, balance sheet controls, reconciliations and financial reporting risks.</li> <li>Have experience testing or reviewing controls, including assessing design and operating effectiveness.</li> <li>Can demonstrate strong attention to detail and ability to challenge evidence, assumptions and process weaknesses.</li> <li>Have experience in documenting robust processes, risks, controls, issues and remediation plans clearly.</li> <li>Have good interpersonal and influencing skills, ability to engage across various internal functions to develop, get buy-in and deliver outcomes across teams</li> <li>Have the ability to confidently present data in a meaningful and effective way; understanding the needs of the end users and tailoring presentations to their requirements</li> <li>Have experience building strong trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity, you'll own three functions that all require hands-on technical depth, not just people management.</p> <p>Platform Staff is a small, senior, AI-native team that moves to wherever the organization needs the most leverage, from standing up early scaffolding for an initiative, to taking on a high-impact customer request that doesn't fit any existing team's charter, to stepping directly into a production crisis until it's resolved.</p> <p>This role is for a technical engineering director who has personally built distributed systems, not only managed people who did. You'll use clear metrics, strong operating rhythms, and direct technical judgment so these teams deliver predictable outcomes without relying on one-person heroics.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own outcomes for Git & Gitaly Operations, including hiring and developing the Manager, Git & Gitaly Operations, and holding the function to its reliability bar across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.</li> <li>Own outcomes for Nonlinear Productivity, also known as Friction Elimination, including hiring and developing the Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, and holding the function to measurable metric movement rather than activity.</li> <li>Build and oversee Platform Staff directly as a small, senior team that uses AI-assisted tools as a standard part of its work.</li> <li>Assess, case by case, what Platform Staff picks up, such as a new team that needs bootstrapping, a customer request too specific for any existing team's charter, or a crisis that needs someone in the room immediately.</li> <li>Assess when Platform Staff should hand work off to a permanent team once it's stable.</li> <li>Set the technical bar across all three functions by personally reviewing distributed systems designs, friction-elimination fixes, and crisis management plans with equal depth.</li> <li>Build the operating rhythm and metrics that keep all three functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours.</li> <li>Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform capabilities so you can assess productivity friction, operational trade-offs, and team needs in context.</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and shipping distributed systems personally, not only through teams you've managed.</li> <li>A track record running highly effective engineering operations, including production reliability and incident management, at meaningful scale.</li> <li>A track record driving measurable engineering productivity improvements across more than one team or organization.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools, and sound judgment about when they help a small team do work that would otherwise require a larger team.</li> <li>People management experience across multiple managers or functions at once.</li> <li>Ability to context-switch effectively across genuinely different problem types, including infrastructure operations, developer productivity, and ad hoc crisis response, sometimes in the same week.</li> <li>A track record making staffing decisions that keep a high-leverage team intentionally small, and building alignment around those decisions rather than growing the team by default.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We work across three connected platform and productivity functions. Through Git & Gitaly Operations, we are responsible for the production reliability of the infrastructure layer underneath GitLab's own version control system. Through Nonlinear Productivity, we drive measurable improvements to GitLab's software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows. Through Platform Staff, we provide focused senior engineering capacity for high-leverage work that needs direct ownership before it can be stabilized or handed off to a permanent team.</p> <p>Collectively, we help GitLab improve the reliability, productivity, and responsiveness of the platform that powers how our customers and GitLab team members build software.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.</p> <p class="p3">Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li3"><span class="s1"><a class="s1"><a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/chatops/">A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on </a><a href="http://GitLab.com">GitLab.com</a></span></li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li3">Support a mix of Self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS) customers, resolving complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.</li> <li class="li3">Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmap, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.</li> <li class="li3">Investigate and troubleshoot issues using Linux systems administration tools, logs, and the GitLab codebase, creating merge requests when needed to resolve customer problems.</li> <li class="li3">Create and update clear, reusable documentation and support content based on real customer interactions and edge cases.</li> <li the SaaS Production team.</li> <li class="li3">Contribute to improving support processes, tools, and automation within our issue tracker to make troubleshooting and case handling more efficient.</li> <li class="li3">Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li3">Experience managing customer-facing technical cases from first contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, and resolution.</li> <li class="li3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge comparable to LFCE or RHCE certification.</li> <li class="li3">Ability to use scripting languages such as Ruby or Bash and work with MVC frameworks such as Ruby on Rails.</li> <li class="li3">Hands-on experience with Git and CI/CD in production or customer environments.</li> <li class="li3">Skill in writing clear, accurate support content and documentation based on real customer scenarios.</li> <li class="li3">Ability to explain complex technical topics to people with varying levels of technical expertise.</li> <li class="li3">Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and Serverless, and how different GitLab implementations operate and impact customers.</li> <li class="li3">Openness to learning, collaborating across teams, and applying transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.</li> </ul> <p class="p4"> </p> <p class="p1"><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p class="p3">We are a artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.</li> <li value="6">Review merge requests and offer feedback to other Monetization data stores for reporting and insights, especially ClickHouse, and the change data capture and event streaming pipelines that feed them, such as NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="5">Experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems.</li> <li value="6">Experience owning a project from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, execution, and monitoring.</li> <li title: Technology and Operational Risk Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland | 💰<strong>€92,000 - €116,000, Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits</strong>|<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Risk team</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an <strong>Operational, Technology and Information Security Risk Senior Manager</strong> in the second line of defence to provide independent oversight, challenge and advisory support on the effectiveness of our operational, technology, resilience and information security risk management practices across the EU. </p> <p>You will be a key member of the second line risk management team and work closely with senior stakeholders across first line technology, information security and operational resilience, to ensure risks are proactively identified, assessed, monitored, and managed in line with Monzo's risk management framework and appetite.</p> <p>This role requires a proactive and strategic mindset, strong technology risk management expertise, and a deep understanding of operational resilience and digital banking operations. </p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Operational Risk, Monzo Europe.</p> <p>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework (IAF) and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <p> <strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as the second line subject matter expert for operational risk, technology (ICT and security risk (including cyber)), and operational resilience.</li> <li>Reviewing and challenging the design and effectiveness of controls over key technology systems, digital infrastructure.</li> <li>Providing effective oversight and challenge of first line risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), incident management and reporting, issue remediation and risk mitigation processes.</li> <li>Providing second line input into our technology and security strategies and business continuity planning.</li> <li>Supporting the ongoing development and maintenance of our Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF), policies, standards and associated ICT,  Security and Resilience policies and risk appetite metrics.</li> <li>Co-ordinating second line assurance reviews and risk deep dives into critical operational and technology areas, providing actionable recommendations and insights.</li> <li>Overseeing ongoing compliance with  the digital operational resilience act (DORA) in the EU and ensuring alignment  with applicable local regulatory standards.</li> <li>Preparing operational and technology risk reports and providing updates to relevant governance forums, including risk committees and senior management.</li> </ul> <p> <strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years’ experience in operational risk, technology risk or related roles in financial services, ideally within a digital or challenger bank, or a pan-European firm. </li> <li>You have a deep knowledge of risk management practices, regulatory expectations, and industry standards related to operational risk, technology and operational resilience. (e.g. EBA Guidelines on ICT & Security Risk Management, DORA, Central Bank of Ireland Guidance on Operational Resilience, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Payment Service Directive (PSD2/PSD3)).</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of digital banking technology, including cloud computing, cybersecurity, fintech integrations and data management.</li> <li>You have experience in evaluating and challenging risk and control environments, particularly in high-growth or fast-changing environments.</li> <li>You are an ambitious risk professional ready to leave the constraints of legacy firms behind. This role places you at the cutting edge of technology and operational risk, challenging you to define the governance needed for our next-generation platforms.</li> <li>You have strong analytical, problem-solving and project management skills.</li> <li>You have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes such as working with regulators/managing regulatory engagements.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 A salary range of €92,000 - €116,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific and behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with Monzo Bank Europe's CRO</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.</p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <h3><strong>We are hiring an HR Generalist to support our growing team</strong> </h3> <p>With 1,200+ colleagues across 75​ ​countries, we require an HR function that thinks and acts globally.​ We're looking for an HR Generalist who will report into our Regional HR Manager who can help build our company as we go through continued growth plans. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. You will demonstrate a high work ethic and the personal confidence to set and defend high expectations of colleagues, counterparts and processes. You must be able to work independently, take a hands-on approach, and interface effectively with professionals at all levels. You'll need excellent communication, professional and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to function in a proactive, innovative environment. We look to HR both to support our colleagues in their personal needs and development, and also to maintain consistently high standards across multiple teams, managers and directors.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>The role entails the individual to:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Provide HR guidance to team members and managers, setting high expectations of behaviour and performance.</li> <li>Partner with line managers to provide employee relations advice on global policies and procedures.</li> <li>Ensure accuracy and timeliness in processing employee changes, joiners and leavers.</li> <li>Manage and drive benefit programs spanning either our EMEA (UK, Ireland, France, Germany and Spain) or AMER (US, Canada and Brazil) locations</li> <li>Liaise with our finance team on monthly payroll, projects and enquiries.</li> <li>Support the full life-cycle of HR including onboarding, benefit administration, and departure.</li> <li>Apply critical thinking to automate and reduce administrative tasks.</li> <li>Take a lead role in the management, continued development, and integration of our HR system.</li> <li>Act as a system expert and advocate for the global HR team.</li> <li>Produce data driven reports to inform and influence HR initiatives.</li> <li>Lead and participate in projects where you’ll see the impact of your work.</li> <li>Support internal resource groups to drive initiatives such as diversity and inclusion.</li> <li>Create, update and maintain corporate policies that have a global lens with local application.</li> <li>Ensure consistency of application of our HR policies and procedures.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Relevant professional qualification and certifications.</li> <li>Excellent practical insights into either EMEA or AMER HR practices and employment laws.</li> <li>Self-directed, organised problem solver with the ability to prioritise and meet goals and deadlines. </li> <li>Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion, sound judgement, tact and diplomacy in all communications.</li> <li>Fearless and principled approach to professional interactions at every level of the business with commitment to confidentiality of sensitive information.</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events, with at least one trip of two full working weeks.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Annual compensation review.</li> <li>Recognition rewards.</li> <li>Annual holiday leave.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: Product Marketing Lead
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p><strong>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</strong></p> <p>Product marketers at Canonical sit between product and the market. They take deeply technical open source products and decide what they mean to a user and a buyer; which problem they solve, who should care, why we win, and what it should cost. That work shows up as positioning and messaging, launch plans, competitive intelligence, global campaigns, and the enablement that helps sales tell a coherent story.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who wants ownership rather than a brief. You will pick up a portfolio area, form your own point of view on the market, and defend it with evidence. We expect product marketers to talk to customers and community members directly, and to bring opinions to product and sales rather than waiting to be told what to say.</p> <p>We have a bias for action, focus effort on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.</p> <p>Location: This role is remote for anyone based in EMEA.</p> <h2>The role entails</h2> <p>You will own product marketing for one of our product areas, from the market thesis through to the assets that sales and campaigns run on. You will be accountable for whether the story lands, whether launches convert, and whether the sales team can repeat the message without you in the room.</p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Own positioning, messaging, and the narrative hierarchy for your product area, and keep it consistent from the website through to the sales deck</li> <li>Lead product launches end to end with tiering, timeline, cross-functional plan, assets, and post-launch reporting</li> <li>Build and maintain the competitive picture for your area: who we lose to, why, and what we say about it</li> <li>Support building the enablement that sales actually uses: battlecards, discovery questions, objection handling, demo narratives</li> <li>Run structured customer and community research, including win-loss, to keep the messaging grounded in real language rather than internal assumptions</li> <li>Partner with demand generation, content, web, and events to turn positioning into campaigns that move pipeline</li> <li>Raise the standard of the craft around you through review, mentoring, and shared frameworks</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication in English</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university</li> <li>Proven product marketing experience in B2B software, SaaS, or open source</li> <li>A track record of owning positioning and messaging for a product or portfolio, not just executing someone else's</li> <li>Evidence of launches you led that changed a business outcome such as adoption, pipeline, or win rate</li> <li>The technical curiosity to hold your own with product managers and engineers and to understand the product beyond the datasheet</li> <li>Comfort using data to test a hypothesis, evaluate a campaign, and change your mind</li> <li>Ability to influence and align stakeholders across product, sales, and marketing without formal authority</li> <li>Excellent storytelling skills applied to technical solutions, for both developer and executive audiences</li> <li>Skill at managing complex, cross-functional projects with several dependencies and a fixed date</li> <li>Fast adaptation to change and to new technology in marketing</li> <li>Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident operating independently at a global scale</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2> <ul> <li>Experience marketing to developers, or in infrastructure, security, or IoT categories</li> <li>Familiarity with open source communities and commercial open source business models</li> <li>Experience across both product-led and sales-led motions, and with the handover between them</li> <li>Public speaking, webinars, or conference presence in a technical field</li> <li>Experience mentoring or leading other product marketers</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  <br>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <p>🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</p> <p>📚Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum</p> <p>💰Annual compensation review</p> <p>🏆Recognition rewards</p> <p>🏝 Annual holiday leave</p> <p>👶Parental Leave</p> <p>🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme</p> <p>🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</p> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect (Customer Success)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working - Native level Japanese, business level English NICE TO HAVES - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy. https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Organisational Development Associate
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>Canonical builds the open-source software that runs the world’s clouds, devices and AI, and we hold our managers to a high standard. Our Talent Development team exists to make leaders and managers at Canonical genuinely excellent. We define what great management looks like here, and we put that standard into the hands of managers and leaders across the company.</p> <p>The Organisational Development Associate is where our most driven early-career people begin. From day one you work with real teams and take on real change, coached hard by senior practitioners on a fast path toward running this work yourself. This is not a support or back-office role, and it is not generalist HR. We hire for potential, drive and coachability over a polished CV, and we back the people we hire to move fast. </p> <p>Applying to this role will enter you into our People Track for consideration across roles in the function.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: These are remote based positions, available across EMEA and the Americas.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Being embedded inside a real team: see how it works day to day, and surface what is and isn't working.</li> <li>Running the diagnostics on a team's health and management effectiveness (engagement, 360, direct feedback), and turning the evidence into a clear, honest read.</li> <li>Owning an improvement end to end: a concrete change to how a team works that you design, drive and land, with a senior practitioner alongside you.</li> <li>Supporting managers in delivering effective 360 performance feedback to individuals and helping them turn it into two or three real commitments they follow through on.</li> <li>Helping build the playbook: the standards, tools and shared language the whole function runs on. You are building the system others use, not producing filler.</li> <li>Learning coaching and organisational development directly from senior practitioners, on a fast, visible path to running this work yourself.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A track record of leading and organising early. You have run things, built things, won people over and made change happen, in a startup, a student society, the military, a team, anywhere. People around you already see you as a driver.</li> <li>A deliberate pull toward developing people and organisations. You chose this field on purpose, with a real grounding in organisational or industrial psychology, behavioural science or a comparable basis. It is not a fallback.</li> <li>Drive and eagerness to learn. You have your own ideas and the confidence to challenge, and you are hungry to be coached and to grow fast.</li> <li>The presence to sit across from experienced people and talk about change with confidence. </li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Up to around two years of experience since graduating.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Organised, accurate, confident, authentic, results-oriented, and enthusiastic.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events. </li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Any exposure to people, organisational, coaching or consulting work, through study, an internship or a first job.</li> <li>A genuine interest in the craft of management and organisations, not just the subject matter.</li> <li>Comfort working with data.</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Annual compensation review.</li> <li>Recognition rewards.</li> <li>Annual holiday leave.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>
